title: Junior Associate - Operations
summary: You'll work in teams of typically 3 - 5 consultants, playing an active role in all aspects of client engagement.

This includes gathering and analyzing information, formulating and testing hypotheses, and developing and communicating recommendations. You'll also present results to client management and implement recommendations in collaboration with client team members.

You will receive exceptional training as well as frequent coaching and mentoring from colleagues on their teams. This support includes a partner from your local office or practice assigned to you to help guide your career as well as up to five weeks of formal training in your first two years as an associate. 1+ years of professional experience
Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
Exceptional problem-solving ability including logical reasoning, creative thinking, comfort with numbers, and the ability to untangle complex issues
Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization
Demonstrated aptitude for analytics

jd_text:
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
When you join us, you will have:
Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity.  We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

jd_text:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:
Imagine a role that builds on your academic and personal capabilities, providing the most interesting business challenges and the opportunity to tackle them with the brightest and most supportive peer group. A role where you’ll make an impact from day one and be set on a global career path that will maximize your future career potential.
We have a long tradition of solving the most challenging problems with notable industry leaders and our junior consultants are the linchpins of this success. If you’re an ambitious individual who enjoys working with the brightest, most curious minds then we’d love you to join our team.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
As a junior consultant, your analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management and leadership skills will be called upon from day one. You will be in thick of the action as you work side-by-side with some of the best in the business. And you will help create change.
Every day is different but a sample of the things you can expect to accomplish include:
Research the client organization and industry; interview, conduct focus groups and facilitate workshops with client employees, management teams and other stakeholders
Identify issues, create hypotheses and execute analysis; translate data into meaningful insights; present recommendations to key decision makers
Move the client to action; develop a plan to implement strategic recommendations; manage the execution.
Everything you do is geared toward achieving bottom-line results for our clients. Along the way, you will also learn to refine your interpersonal and people management skills. This helps you to properly identify client needs, build deeper client relationships and gain consensus—all of which make you a better leader.
Learning as a Bain JC takes many other forms, from formal global training programs to informal mentoring on a day-to-day basis. The overall experience is incredibly enriching from both a personal and a professional standpoint.
Successful Bain JCs are recognized not only for their excellent analytical skills but also for their interpersonal abilities and team skills.
Given the workload and performance expectations of this position, JCs are regularly required to work more than 60 hours/week to perform essential duties of the job.
ABOUT YOU:
MBA from a top business school; MDs, JDs, PhDs and experienced professionals are also encouraged to apply
Experience in consulting, a start-up or other business environment beneficial, but not required
A solid team player who’s also an independent thinker
A robust analytical skillset, endless curiosity and a penchant to think the impossible
Must be deadline driven, organized and able to multi-task
Strong verbal, written and presentation skills are important
Sharp problem-solving skills
A results-oriented track record
Solid leadership experience
A passion for consulting—and for life
Since Bain is a general management consulting firm, we are not looking for individuals with specific industry expertise. Our JCs do not enter an industry practice area and do not specialize until later in their careers. We look for people who possess a high level of energy and a sincere desire to affect change in diverse industries on diverse client challenges.
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external institutions such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Consultant, Transform Practice
summary: As a generalist Consultant affiliated to BCG Transform practice, you will be working alongside some of the world’s top minds in the industry. You will work hand in hand with the decision makers of our client company, having a real seat at the table. Through your project you will accompany companies from a variety of sectors and industries through decisive changes around the globe. The majority of your time will be spent as part of the BCG Transform team composed of members of different backgrounds collaborating intensively and building a long-term relation with our client.

You will also dedicate time to further develop and deepen BCG’s expertise in restructuring and turnaround, as well as supporting BCG Partners in business development initiatives. On a day to day basis this will translate in:
Contribute to BCG Transform’s growth in operational and financial restructuring through active case work, client relations, and creating valuable IP and products.
qualifications_required: Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in turnaround and restructuring topics
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Consulting Experience: Experience working with clients across various industries, helping them tackle their most difficult challenges and create sustainable value.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in team settings and interact with diverse stakeholders.
Fluent oral and written language skills: German and English
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here  for more information on E-Verify.
keywords: strategy, transformation, digital, technology, client
jd_text:
Locations: Germany | Austria
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
Practice Area
Business Transformation is essential to adapt to ever-changing conditions—even for companies that are already dominating their markets. It’s a big challenge, but BCG’s business transformation consultants can help clients put the odds in their favor. To view the Consultant job description for our Montreal office, click here.
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:
Imagine a role that builds on your academic and personal capabilities, providing the most interesting business challenges and the opportunity to tackle them with the brightest and most supportive peer group. A role where you’ll make an impact from day one and be set on a global career path that will maximize your future career potential.

As a Bain consultant, your analytical, interpersonal, creative thinking, business management and leadership skills will be called upon from day one. You will be in the thick of the action as you work side-by-side with some of the best in the business. And you will help create change.
Every day is different but a sample of the things you can expect to accomplish include:
Research the client organization and industry; interview, conduct focus groups and facilitate workshops with client employees, management teams and other stakeholders
Identify issues, create hypotheses and execute analysis; translate data into meaningful insights; present recommendations to key decision makers
Move the client to action; develop a plan to implement the strategic recommendations; manage the execution
Be a mentor to junior team members
The learning curve is steep and the rewards – global travel, influential connections, world-class global training, personal satisfaction, unparalleled career-development, and, yes, financial – are second to none.
Given the workload and performance expectations of this position, consultants are regularly required to work more than 50 hours/week to perform essential duties of the job.
ABOUT YOU:
The following are typical requirements to apply for the Consultant position. Please check our office information for exact deadlines, any office-specific requirements and application information.
MBA from a top business school; MDs, JDs, PhDs and experienced professionals are also encouraged to apply
Experience in consulting, a start-up or other business environment beneficial, but not required
A solid team player who’s also an independent thinker
A robust analytical skillset, endless curiosity and a penchant to think the impossible
Must be deadline driven, organized and able to multi-task
Strong verbal, written and presentation skills are important
Fluency in English
Any additional language and visa requirements for the office you wish to join
COMPENSATION:
For all locations, the good-faith, reasonable annualized full-time compensation for this role is commensurate with competitive geographic market rates. In some locations, compensation may vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, education, licensure/certifications, training, and skill level.
Bain's comprehensive benefits and wellness programs are designed to support your emotional, physical, and professional needs:
Wellbeing: Health plans for employees and families that go beyond the basics to include mental, emotional, and behavioral health resources, counseling, assistance, and digital wellness tools
Financial Security: Life, accident, disability, as well as tax efficient programs and retirement savings, where applicable, and extras through various expense and office policies
Flexibility: Paid holidays, vacation, personal sick time, flexibility, and accommodation. Plus, flexible breaks and family leave policies
Learning: A culture of mentorship across all roles, and full lifecycle career support, training, and planning
Compensation for this role in the United States includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service, and Bain's best in class benefits package (details listed above).
The annualized base compensation for first-year Consultants in the United States is $200,000. This role may also be eligible for other elements of discretionary compensation.
Note for Italy
In accordance with applicable Italian pay transparency requirements, Bain & Company provides information regarding the compensation applicable to this position.
The annualized base salary for this role in Italy is €85,000 gross per year.
This compensation has been determined based on objective and gender-neutral criteria and reflects the compensation normally applicable to this position at the time of publication.
This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 44% of base salary.
Bonus awards are discretionary and actual bonus outcomes depend on individual and firm performance.
This position is subject to the provisions of Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro per i Dirigenti Industria
WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

From day one, you’ll build a strong foundation and business toolkit, working across a wide range of industries and contributing to work that helps global clients, including senior executives and C-level leaders, address complex strategic issues and translate them into actionable plans.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Associate Consultants are integral members of our consulting teams, working alongside teammates across levels on case teams embedded within client organizations, including many of the world’s leading companies. You’ll bring fresh thinking, structured problem solving, and a collaborative spirit to help solve high-impact business challenges.
Here’s a snapshot of what you’ll do:
Break down complex problems using hypothesis-led thinking and rigorous analysis to generate insights that shape strategic decisions
Own discrete workstreams such as market sizing, financial modeling, scenario planning, or benchmarking to deliver clear, actionable recommendations
Use data, tools, and digital platforms, which may include Bain’s proprietary platforms and emerging capabilities such as generative AI to support analysis and decision making
Adapt and deliver by taking on varied responsibilities depending on the needs of each case, from research and analysis to implementation support
HOW BAIN WILL SUPPORT YOU
While the learning curve is steep and the work is challenging, you’ll be supported every step of the way through training, mentorship, and a culture that helps you thrive. You’ll learn from colleagues across regions, tapping into Bain’s global network of expertise, resources, and shared communities. Whether on a case, in training, or through firmwide initiatives, you’ll build meaningful relationships and expand your perspective.

If you’re ambitious and energized by working with exceptional people, Bain is an exciting place to launch and grow your career.

Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities, Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I),R&I-Hyderabad/Mumbai
 If you are passionate about providing quality insights obtained through research and would like to leverage your strengths to support Deloitte’s thoughtware, this could be the role for you. The role provides an opportunity to get involved in activities that help develop and deliver Deloitte’s thought leadership and client briefings in the power and utilities sector (P&U) and renewable energy (RE) industry. A self-motivated individual who is accustomed to working well in a close-knit team would be a good fit. As part of this team, you’ll gain exposure to a variety of resources and collaboration opportunities that will help in developing your skills and professional development.
 Please explore deloitte.com and deloitte.com/insights to explore our papers and capabilities.
 Work you'll do
 As a Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities on the Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) Research & Insights (R&I) team, you will be responsible for…
 * Developing research proposals and hypotheses for thought leadership and client briefings focused on the power and utilities and renewable energy industries.
 * Conducting secondary research, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, and synthesizing findings into industry perspectives.
 * Applying research methodologies, including surveys, financial analysis, and case studies, to support business decision-making.
 * Preparing research briefings, written materials, and presentation content for clients and Deloitte leaders.
 * Collaborating with project leads and senior team members in the United States and India to deliver research projects.
 The team
 The PU&R sector is part of the broader Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) industry team within the R&I group. The ER&I industry team comprises individuals with varied subject matter expertise and skill sets that enables members to work both independently and collaboratively on small and large projects.
 The overall R&I group’s objective is to develop compelling and forward-looking perspectives that allow clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The perspectives are formed by regular scanning and analysis of shaping trends, industry and company level developments, and regulatory environment. The group plays an integral role in strengthening the firm's strategic positioning in the marketplace and through end-to-end development of high-quality thoughtware.
 Location: Mumbai, Hyderabad
 Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM
 Qualifications
 Required:
 * Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management (PGDBM).
 * 3-4 years of experience conducting research, analysis, and writing in United States power and utilities or renewable energy markets.
 * Experience developing research proposals and hypotheses and conducting secondary research.
 * Experience analyzing quantitative and qualitative data and producing written research reports, client briefings, or presentation materials.
 * Experience applying at least one research methodology: surveys, financial analysis, case studies, forecasting or simulation, text analysis, regulatory review, mergers and acquisitions analysis, or social-media research.
 * Experience using one or more online research databases, including Bloomberg, Hoovers, Factiva, OneSource, Thomson, or AlphaSense.
 * Experience preparing business presentations for clients or senior leaders.
 Preferred:
 * Experience tracking and summarizing government filings and company strategy in the United States power and utilities or renewable energy industries.
 * Experience using Tableau or Microsoft Power BI to develop data visualizations.
 * Experience using generative artificial intelligence tools for research or productivity workflows and validating source information before including it in research outputs.
 * Experience working with virtual teams in India and the United States.

EY-Parthenon Quality supports the business in maintaining quality, consistency and accountability across engagements. * Identify documentation gaps, quality concerns, risk indicators, and matters requiring escalation.

Job Profile: Payer Modernization – Healthcare Transformation & Analytics
Role Overview
We are looking for professionals with experience in healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.
Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:
* Healthcare Back Office Transformation
* Healthcare Middle Office Transformation
* Payer Analytics & Data Strategy
Key Responsibilities
* Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.
* Assess existing processes and develop process maps, workflow assessments, operating models, and improvement recommendations.
* Conduct benchmarking, workforce assessments, research, and cost-benefit analyses to identify improvement opportunities.
* Support transformation across payer functions such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, care management, utilization management, pharmacy/PBM, network management, payment integrity, and risk adjustment.
* Analyze large and complex healthcare datasets to identify trends, operational issues, and actionable business insights.
* Support technology-enabled operating model transformation, including workflow redesign, system implementation, platform optimization, and process automation.
* Contribute to analytics initiatives addressing risk adjustment, quality, utilization, care management, pharmacy performance, and payment integrity.
* Support data governance and effective communication of analytical insights to business and operational stakeholders.
* Use GenAI to support research, insight development, and storyboarding where appropriate.
* Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI/ML, NLP, interoperability, and data exchange to improve payer processes.
Essential Knowledge & Experience
* Understanding of healthcare payer operations and core functions.
* Experience supporting operational, strategic, technology, analytics, or transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of payer workflows such as claims, enrollment, eligibility, billing, provider data, benefits, care management, and utilization management.
* Familiarity with process mapping, workflow assessment, operating models, project management, or benchmarking.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.
* Experience working with complex datasets.
* Understanding of payer technology platforms and system-enabled process improvement.
* Ability to communicate analytical and technical insights clearly to business stakeholders.
Preferred Knowledge & Experience
* Understanding of Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models.
* Familiarity with risk adjustment, HCCs, Stars, HEDIS, CAHPS, and compliance-driven payer activities.
* Understanding of Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) concepts such as formulary design, utilization management, rebates, pharmacy networks, and drug-spend analytics.
* Awareness of CMS oversight, payer regulatory requirements, audits, and compliance processes.
* Understanding of value-based care and payment models.
* Experience with payer analytics use cases involving risk adjustment, quality, care management, utilization, pharmacy, or payment integrity.

Work you’ll do
Deloitte is growing its Strategy, Risk, and Transaction (SR&T) – Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) practice in Southeast Asia. We work with senior executives of our clients on shareholder value, inorganic growth, and portfolio rationalization by offering financial, M&A, and debt & equity advice. Use deep analytics and AI to align deal strategy with corporate goals, maximize benefits, and support integrations, separations, and transformation.
The Post Merger Integration (PMI) team helps corporate, private equity, and government clients realise transaction value through the successful planning and execution of integrations. We support clients from pre-close planning through Day 1 readiness and post-close execution, helping them establish integration strategies, governance structures, operating models, and synergy realization plans. By bringing together people, processes, technology, and culture, we help organisations capture deal value faster, minimise disruption, manage integration risks, and achieve their strategic objectives.
You will work alongside our clients to solve complex integration challenges and deliver sustainable business outcomes. Leveraging rigorous analytical thinking, structured problem solving, and practical execution support, you will help clients make critical decisions throughout the integration lifecycle. This includes identifying value creation opportunities, managing cross-functional dependencies, driving stakeholder alignment, and translating strategic objectives into actionable integration plans that support long-term growth and transformation.
The nature of the work we do includes:
* Lead workstreams in integration planning and execution, including synergy realization, risk mitigation, and stakeholder alignment.
* Design and oversee detailed integration roadmaps, governance frameworks, and KPIs.
* Conduct in-depth data analysis to identify trends, measure progress, and proactively address challenges.
* Oversee and ensure updates to project plans, milestones, and documentation are accurate and timely.
* Identify and manage dependencies, risks, and deliverables to ensure seamless project execution.
* Prepare and present detailed status reports and updates for executive leadership and clients.
* Drive research efforts and strategic analysis to support M&A initiatives.
* Lead market and industry assessments, and oversee target screening processes.
* Work closely with leadership to develop proposals, high-impact presentations, and client deliverables.
* Lead workshops and meetings to facilitate decision-making and issue resolution.
* Mentor junior team members, providing guidance on analysis, reporting, and client engagement.

* Offer insights based on a solid understanding of what makes Deloitte successful.
* Project integrity and confidence while motivating others through team collaboration as well as recognising individual strengths, differences, and contributions.

* Possess an undergraduate degree with strong academic credentials in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline. A Master's degree or relevant postgraduate qualification is advantageous.

Job Description & Summary
Senior AI Consultant, AI Trust & Governance
Make an impact with us
At PwC, you will help organisations build trust and deliver meaningful outcomes in a changing world. You will work in an inclusive and collaborative environment where diverse perspectives, continuous learning and responsible innovation are valued.
About the team
Our AI Trust team, within Assurance, helps organisations adopt and scale artificial intelligence responsibly, practically and sustainably.
We translate regulatory requirements, risk principles and responsible AI concepts into workable governance models, lifecycle processes and controls. Our goal is not governance for its own sake. We help clients use AI with confidence while managing risk throughout the AI lifecycle.
What your day will look like
You will work with multidisciplinary client teams across business, risk, technology, data, legal and compliance. Your responsibilities will include: 
* Designing practical AI governance structures, operating models, policies, processes and decision rights.
* Identifying AI systems and use cases, assessing their risks and defining proportionate governance requirements.
* Translating the EU AI Act and other relevant AI regulations into concrete actions, controls and documentation.
* Assessing existing AI controls, identifying gaps and embedding controls throughout the AI lifecycle.
* Conducting responsible AI and use case assessments covering transparency, human oversight, robustness, data governance, accountability, bias and explainability.
* Supporting the responsible rollout of Copilot and other Generative AI solutions.
* Helping clients turn complex AI risk and regulatory topics into clear guidance for business and technology teams.
* Contributing to client conversations, thought leadership and the continued development of our AI Trust services.
* Depending on your experience, you may also contribute to model validation, testing, monitoring, red teaming and AI assurance
What we will expect from you
* At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in consulting, AI governance, risk, technology, data, internal controls or digital transformation.
* A Master's degree in Business Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field.
* Practical knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI principles, the EU AI Act and other relevant AI legislation.
* Experience designing or assessing governance frameworks, risk management processes, controls or operating models.
* Experience with AI, data, technology or digital risk, together with enough technical understanding to work confidently with technical teams.
* The ability to take ownership of a defined workstream, structure ambiguous problems and turn analysis into clear recommendations and client ready deliverables.
* A communicative, collaborative and results oriented approach, with the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.
* The ability to build trusted relationships, involve diverse perspectives and adapt your communication to different audiences.
* A learning mindset and a willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues and contribute to an inclusive team environment.
* You are fluent in Dutch and/or French, with full professional proficiency in English.
Experience with Generative AI, foundation model risk, AI lifecycle controls, governance risk and compliance tooling, regulated industries or complex organisations is an advantage. 
Relevant certifications, including AIGP, GARP Risk and AI or ISO IEC 42001 Lead Implementer, are also valued.
What you can expect from us
* Challenging and meaningful work at the intersection of AI, regulation, risk and technology.
* Ownership of high impact client work, supported by collaborative and multidisciplinary teams.
* Continuous learning, mentorship and opportunities to deepen your AI Trust expertise.
* Exposure to different clients, sectors and strategic technology solutions.
* A flexible and inclusive environment where people are respected and encouraged to grow.
* Opportunities to build trusted client relationships and help shape our evolving AI Trust services.
Ready to make a difference
This is not primarily a legal interpretation or AI development role. It connects AI technology, regulation, governance risk and organisational realities.
If you want to help organisations use AI confidently and responsibly, while developing your expertise in a supportive, ambitious and fast paced environment, we would like to hear from you.
PwC is committed to equal opportunities, diversity and respect. Recruitment data is handled in accordance with GDPR and applicable Belgian employment standards.

jd_text:
Job Description & Summary
PwC, cabinet pluridisciplinaire, rassemble 7 000 collaborateurs en France et au Maghreb, au sein d’un réseau mondial de plus de 364 000 personnes dans 136 pays. Chaque jour, nous exerçons des métiers d’excellence pour concrétiser notre ambition : être utiles à nos clients et accélérateurs de mouvement. 
Dans un monde en constante évolution, nous investissons dans le développement de nos équipes avec une proposition de valeur forte : Grow here. Go further. Un engagement mondial pour accompagner nos talents dans l’évolution de leurs compétences. 
Ce que nous recherchons ? Des expertises, bien sûr. Mais surtout, des personnalités curieuses, passionnées, prêtes à incarner les comportements du PwC Professional, notre référentiel commun qui guide notre manière de travailler ensemble. 
Reconnu Top Employer pour la 6ème année consécutive, PwC s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et handi-accueillant, où chacun peut pleinement collaborer et avoir un impact. Si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésitez pas à nous en faire part.
Notre équipe 
Au sein de la practice Finance, notre équipe Consulting accompagne la transformation des Directions Financières de grands groupes français et internationaux, mais aussi les acteurs de la French Tech et du Next40. Nos projets embarquent toutes les dimensions technologiques et digitales. 
Dans le cadre du développement des équipes « Finance » à Paris, nous recherchons un(e) consultant(e) pour participer à des projets de transformation de Directions Financières de grandes Institutions Financières (Banque, Assurance, Gestion d’actifs). 
Vos missions 
Si vous vous reconnaissez dans l’une des affirmations ci-dessous, votre profil nous intéresse !  
- Vous avez envie de vous confronter aux enjeux business de réduction de coûts, de publication sur le marché, de pilotage de la performance 
- Vous êtes auditeur financier et souhaitez accompagner différemment vos clients via une expérience en consulting 
- Vous souhaitez accompagner les directions financières de grands groupes bancaires et assuranciels sur ces thématiques et disposez d’une expertise sur un ou plusieurs de ces sujets : 
* FP&A (Banque / Assurance) 
* TOM-FI (Banque / Assurance) 
* ESG Finance (Banque / Assurance) 
* Consolidation comptable (Banque / Assurance) 
* RPA / Machine Learning / IA for finance (Banque / Assurance) 
Parmi nos missions emblématiques : 
* Accompagner la transformation d’une direction financière, 
* Préparer une organisation pour répondre aux exigences du reporting ESG, 
* Répondre à des enjeux business d’alignement des reporting de consolidation et de gestion et refondre le processus de reporting, 
* Accompagner nos clients lors d’opérations exceptionnelles, dans un contexte de fusion / acquisition, par exemple, à la refonte du reporting et la réalisation de la reprise des historiques,  
* Améliorer le processus de clôture et de reporting dans un objectif de réduction des délais de publication sur le marché, 
* Appui à la performance et mise en place d’outils EPM, de consolidation ou de Data Visualisation : aider au choix et mettre en œuvre de nouveaux systèmes d’information financiers (Anaplan, Tagetik, SAP ou Oracle, Power BI, Tableau, …), 
* Reporting et consolidation : améliorer la production et l'analyse des données financières et opérationnelles, optimiser et automatiser les reporting. 
Votre profil
* Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’un Bac+5 d'une école d'ingénieur ou de commerce, IEP ou 3ème cycle universitaire spécialisé en finance/gestion 
* Vous avez une expérience de 3 ans minimum en cabinet de conseil ou en entreprise, où vous avez déjà contribué à un ou plusieurs projets touchant les thématiques ou les outils évoqués (Consolidation comptable, FP&A, Fast close, E-Invoicing, Pilier 2, IA for Finance, SAP, Anaplan, etc.) 
* Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse, de synthèse, êtes à l’écoute, rigoureux(se), et impactant(e) à l’oral 
* Vous êtes à l’aise dans des environnements exigeants, complexes et prêt à vous engager au service de nos clients 
* Vous avez une excellente communication écrite et orale, en français et en anglais 
Vos avantages 
* Un environnement technologique innovant : accès à des outils de pointe comme le Tech Lab, Copilot M365 et l’IA Factory pour façonner le monde de demain.

CONSULTANT – Industria 4.0 & Business Incentives (Milano)
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
Se cerchi un percorso di crescita in un contesto internazionale dove le tue idee contano davvero, sei nel posto giusto. Perché candidarsi in EY?
Lo abbiamo chiesto a chi ci lavora già! Questi i fattori più influenti: 
* Investimento sulle competenze del futuro: In EY la tecnologia non sostituisce il contributo delle persone: lo amplifica. Per questo investiamo nello sviluppo di competenze, relazioni e capacità di giudizio che permettono di affrontare le sfide più complesse e generare valore sostenibile nel tempo. Fin dal primo giorno, avrai accesso a eventi, strumenti e corsi sull’Intelligenza Artificiale, per imparare a usare la tecnologia come leva per amplificare il tuo impatto.
* Formazione continua: oltre 50 ore di corsi tecnici e manageriali all’anno previsti per ciascuna persona; per integrare apprendimento e lavoro quotidiano, trasformando ogni progetto in un’occasione di crescita.
* Sviluppo e progressione di carriera: solo negli ultimi 12 mesi, oltre la metà delle persone di EY si è vista riconoscere un avanzamento di carriera; con percorsi in cui competenze, potenziale e contributo individuale diventano elementi centrali.
* Mobilità e opportunità internazionali, compresa la possibilità di lavorare in smart working dall’estero fino a 20 giorni senza essere in trasferta; 
* Lavoro ibrido senza giornate prestabilite centralmente.
* Un network internazionale su cui poter contare.
Vuoi dare forma al tuo futuro insieme a noi? 
Scopri nel concreto che cosa fa un/una Consultant nel team di Industria 4.0 & Business Incentives
Il team Finance della Service Line Business Consulting è dedicato alla Finance Transformation e ad attività legate a incentivi e contributi alle imprese. Ti interfaccerai con clienti nazionali e internazionali appartenenti a diversi settori (manufacturing, energy, pharma, automotive, telecomunicazioni, ecc.), contribuendo allo sviluppo e alla gestione dei progetti.
Avrai l’opportunità di lavorare su progetti caratterizzati da una forte componente tecnica, economico-finanziaria e normativa, supportando le aziende nell’analisi e nella valorizzazione dei propri investimenti. Lavorerai al fianco di professionisti esperti per clienti di grandi dimensioni, crescendo rapidamente sul campo.
Nello specifico contribuirai all’implementazione dei servizi Finance connessi agli incentivi agli investimenti e all’innovazione, con particolare riferimento a Transizione 5.0 e Patent Box per le aziende clienti.
Chi stiamo cercando? Persone con:
* Laurea magistrale in materie tecnico-scientifiche (preferibilmente in Ingegneria) o in Economia
* Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative
* Ottima conoscenza del pacchetto Office (con particolare riferimento a Excel e Power Point)
* Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese
Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza pregressa in contesti operanti nella Finanza Agevolata.
In EY potrai:
* Accelerare le tue competenze: grazie a programmi di sviluppo orientati al futuro e a strumenti AI che automatizzano attività ripetitive, potrai dedicare più tempo all'analisi, alla consulenza, all'innovazione e alla costruzione di relazioni professionali ad alto impatto.
* Allargare i tuoi orizzonti: lavora in team internazionali e multidisciplinari, confrontandoti con prospettive diverse e contribuendo a sviluppare soluzioni che combinano tecnologia, competenze specialistiche e intuizione umana.
* Dare il meglio di te: Investi costantemente nel tuo benessere personale e nello sviluppo della tua carriera, con una figura di Counselor che ti supporta dal primo giorno.
Avrai infine l’opportunità di:
* accedere a benefits e programmi di welfare aziendale diversificati;
* partecipare a programmi di leadership.
Per la presente posizione è previsto un range retributivo compreso tra 29.500€ e 33.000€, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. Il rapporto di lavoro è regolato dal CCNL Commercio; il livello di inquadramento contrattuale e collettivo e la relativa disciplina applicabile saranno determinati in coerenza con l’esperienza e il profilo professionale della risorsa inserita nel processo di selezione. Per la specifica posizione è previsto un bonus al raggiungimento di obiettivi preventivamente comunicati e concordati.
In EY crediamo che ciascuna persona porti con sé qualcosa di unico:
Le tue esperienze, ambizioni e prospettive contribuiscono a creare un ambiente in cui l’unicità di ognuno diventa la nostra forza collettiva.
Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva, dove tutte le voci sono ascoltate e valorizzate: Together, all in.
Valorizziamo ogni forma di unicità — età, genere, abilità, esperienza, cultura, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità e background socioeconomico — e assicuriamo che tutte le nostre offerte siano aperte anche a persone con disabilità, in linea con la legge italiana L.68/99.
Per offrirti la migliore esperienza possibile nel processo di selezione, ti invitiamo a segnalarci eventuali esigenze o supporti di cui potresti avere bisogno.
EY | La nostra missione? Building a better working world 
In EY ci occupiamo di consulenza direzionale, strategica, legale, tributaria, tecnologica, organizzativa e di revisione contabile. Lo facciamo attraverso un network mondiale di servizi professionali presente in oltre 150 Paesi in tutto il mondo. Als Teil unseres interdisziplinären Regulatory, Risk & Compliance Transformation Hubs in München, Stuttgart, Berlin, Hamburg, Frankfurt/Main, Düsseldorf oder Köln berätst du führende Finanzinstitute, Zentralbanken und Aufsichtsbehörden an der Schnittstelle von Regulatorik, Geschäftsprozessen und digitaler Innovation. jd_text:
La oportunidad:
Consultor Senior de Valuación y Riesgos Financieros
Sobre EY México:
EY es una de las firmas de servicios profesionales más grandes del mundo, comprometida con la construcción de un mejor mundo de trabajo. En EY México ayudamos a organizaciones líderes a resolver desafíos complejos mediante soluciones innovadoras, tecnología y talento de primer nivel. Nuestro entorno fomenta el desarrollo profesional continuo, la colaboración y la excelencia técnica, permitiendo que nuestros profesionales generen un impacto significativo en clientes, equipos y comunidades.
Sobre FAAS:
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) es una práctica especializada dentro de Assurance que ayuda a las organizaciones a enfrentar retos contables, financieros y regulatorios. Nuestro equipo asesora a compañías de diversas industrias en la aplicación de normas contables, valuación de instrumentos financieros, gestión de riesgos, transacciones complejas y reporteo financiero, contribuyendo a la toma de decisiones estratégicas y al cumplimiento de estándares nacionales e internacionales.
Acerca del rol:
Buscamos un Consultor Senior de Valuación y Riesgos Financieros para integrarse a nuestro equipo especializado en instrumentos financieros y quantitative finance. Esta posición brinda la oportunidad de trabajar con clientes de auditoría y consultoría de diversos sectores, participando en proyectos relacionados con valuación de instrumentos financieros, análisis cuantitativo, gestión de riesgos y tratamientos contables bajo distintos marcos normativos.
El profesional será responsable de desarrollar análisis técnicos complejos, elaborar entregables de alta calidad, colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios y contribuir activamente al éxito de los proyectos mediante una sólida combinación de conocimientos financieros, habilidades analíticas y orientación al cliente.
Requerimientos y actividades
Actividades:
* Participar en la valuación de instrumentos financieros y derivados mediante metodologías cuantitativas y modelos financieros.
* Analizar información de mercado, indicadores económicos y variables financieras para soportar ejercicios de valuación y riesgo.
* Desarrollar y ejecutar modelos financieros, regresiones y análisis estadísticos utilizando herramientas especializadas.
* Interpretar contratos financieros, documentación técnica y normativa aplicable para evaluar impactos contables y financieros.
* Elaborar memorandos técnicos, informes, reportes y presentaciones ejecutivas para clientes y equipos internos.
* Participar en proyectos relacionados con gestión de riesgos financieros, fair value, impairment y otros temas especializados.
* Colaborar con gerentes y socios en la atención a clientes, asegurando el cumplimiento de entregables y fechas compromiso.
* Guiar y apoyar a profesionales junior en actividades técnicas y revisión de trabajos. 
Requerimientos:
* Licenciatura concluida en Economía, Finanzas, Actuaría, Ingeniería Financiera o carreras afines.
* Experiencia de 2 a 3 años en instituciones financieras, banca, consultoría financiera, valuación o áreas relacionadas.
* Nivel de inglés intermedio o superior.
* Dominio avanzado de Excel.
* Conocimiento de Python y/o R para análisis cuantitativo y modelación financiera.
* Experiencia en valuación de instrumentos financieros, derivados o gestión de riesgos financieros.
* Conocimientos contables relacionados con instrumentos financieros bajo IFRS, US GAAP u otros marcos normativos relevantes.
* Capacidad para gestionar múltiples proyectos simultáneamente y trabajar de forma autónoma.
* Excelentes habilidades analíticas, atención al detalle y orientación a resultados.
* Deseable: CFA Nivel I o certificaciones financieras equivalentes.
Competencias clave:
* Pensamiento crítico y resolución de problemas.
* Adaptabilidad y aprendizaje continuo.
* Comunicación efectiva.
* Orientación al cliente.
* Colaboración y trabajo en equipo.
* Conocimiento técnico financiero y contable.
* Curiosidad intelectual y mentalidad analítica.
* Inteligencia emocional y construcción de relaciones.
* Integridad y compromiso con la calidad.
Lo que ofrecemos:
En EY México valoramos a nuestros colaboradores y ofrecemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, dinámico y orientado al desarrollo profesional. Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con especialistas líderes en quantitative finance y riesgos financieros, participar en proyectos de alto impacto para clientes nacionales e internacionales y acceder a programas de capacitación continua, certificaciones y crecimiento profesional.
Además, ofrecemos un paquete competitivo de compensación y beneficios, esquemas de trabajo flexibles y una cultura basada en colaboración, innovación y bienestar integral.
Forma parte de EY y desarrolla tu carrera en uno de los equipos más especializados de instrumentos financieros y riesgos del mercado.
En EY México la diversidad, equidad e inclusión son un imperativo para nuestra organización. Nuestros procesos de reclutamiento y selección son acordes a lo establecido en la legislación laboral, razón por la cual, no se discrimina en función de las categorías protegidas en derechos humanos aplicables a la firma. Igualmente, en conformidad con el artículo 5 de la Ley Federal para Prevenir y Eliminar la Discriminación no se entenderá como discriminación la distinción basada en criterios razonables, proporcionales y objetivos cuya finalidad no sea el menoscabo de derechos. Todos los datos sensibles proporcionados a EY en el proceso de reclutamiento y de manera posterior son protegidos de conformidad con la Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en posesión de los particulares. Finalmente, en caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable en el proceso de postulación favor de especificarlo.

jd_text:
Chez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur. 
EY Studio+ réunit les expertises d’EY en design et stratégie d’innovation, technologie, marketing et expérience client pour créer des solutions intégrées et transformer de bout en bout la relation client. Ses équipes pluridisciplinaires — soutenues par 600 talents en France (parmi les 7000 du réseau EY Global) — combinent vision stratégique, créativité et technologies avancées pour accompagner les organisations à façonner des parcours clients performants, centrés sur l’humain, et accélérer leur transformation.
Notre Opportunité : 
Au sein de notre équipe, 50 consultants spécialisés sur les sujets Marketing Sales & Services accompagnent les grandes entreprises internationales sur le cadrage et la conduite de projets de transformation majeurs.
Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un Consultant Senior en Customer & Business Transformation F/H. Vous serez amené à conduire des projets de définition de stratégies marketing, de construction de la relation client de demain ou encore de digitalisation de l'expérience client, en collaboration avec toutes les équipes transverses d’EY (Experience Design, Analytics, IT, Strategy…)
Vos principales responsabilités 
Au sein de nos équipes vous participez à des missions visant à :
* Cadrer des projets d'envergure de transformation CRM, E-commerce et Marketplace :
- En tant que senior, je décrypte les nouveaux standards de l’expérience client et je cadre des besoins métiers
* Développer une stratégie marketing pour nos clients :
- En tant que senior, je rédige des plans marketings et lance de nouveaux produits, offres et services
* Accompagner nos clients sur des sujets nouveaux et innovants (Gen AI, Sustainability & Digital) :
- En tant que senior, j’apporte des éclairages sur des innovations, j’organise et anime des ateliers d'identification de cas d'usage métiers que je décline en feuille de route
* Piloter de grands projets internationaux de bout en bout du cadrage jusqu’à l’implémentation :
- En tant que senior, je conduis des activités et fournis des livrables clients en autonomie
* Participer au développement commercial de l’équipe et de l’entreprise :
- En tant que senior, je réalise des propositions commerciales pour des prospects et suis à l’écoute d’opportunités chez mes clients
Vos Compétences pour réussir : 
* Expérience significative d’au moins 2 ans en Conseil avec une expertise digitale forte, à la fois stratégique, technologique et centrée client.
* Niveau d’anglais courant (oral et écrit)
* Une expérience sur les sujets CRM ou data est un plus.
Ce que nous recherchons : 
* Formation supérieure de haut niveau (grande école d’ingénieurs ou grande école de commerce)
* Une personne dynamique et dotée d'un excellent sens relationnel
* Une capacité d’adaptation à des environnements variés face à des interlocuteurs de comité de direction
* Un très bon sens du service client
* Avoir de bonnes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse
Ce que nous vous offrons : 
* Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif.
* Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY
* L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U.
* Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo.
* De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris..
Etes-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui.
Processus de recrutement : 
Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 entretiens (RH et métier). Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions. Lors des entretiens métiers, nous vous proposerons également un exercice d’étude de cas ou market sizing à réaliser in situ.
Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.
EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.

Our People Consulting Service Line is focusing on all workforce topics and we help our clients get it right in all its facets – from talent management, HR systems, people analytics, learning, to culture change and human centered change management.
To further strengthen our People Consulting team in the field of Change Management, we are looking for a Consultant to join our Geneva, Basel, or Zurich office. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced colleagues to help clients evolve their ways of working in the context of technology-enabled transformation, workplace, or culture evolution.

What we look for

* Ability to work in large, international, and interdisciplinary teams

jd_text:
EY es una firma global líder que ofrece servicios de Auditoría, Consultoría, Estrategia y Transacciones e Impuestos, con una red integrada por más de 400.000 profesionales en 150 países del mundo.   
Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo mejor de negocios para nuestra gente, para nuestros clientes y para nuestras comunidades. Trabajamos continuamente para mejorar la calidad de nuestros servicios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente y en innovación. Las oportunidades de crecer, tener éxito y desarrollarse en EY son ilimitadas.   
EY cree en la igualdad de oportunidades y no discrimina por motivos de género, edad, estado civil, credo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, origen étnico u origen nacional, discapacidad o características físicas. 
Todas nuestras oportunidades de trabajo están abiertas a personas con discapacidad y buscamos alentar a que se postulen para nuestras diferentes posiciones. En caso de necesitar algún ajuste razonable o apoyo, por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación. 
Acerca del área
Financial Services Office (FSO) es una de nuestras áreas integrada por estrategas empresariales, tecnólogos/as y líderes de la industria que aportan un pensamiento y conocimiento fresco del sector sobre banca y mercado de capitales, seguros, gestión de activos y patrimonio.   
En FSO Business Consulting contamos con un equipo de Business Transformation que participa en una amplia cartera de propuestas de valor que sirven para ampliar y diseñar una trayectoria de transformación integral (personas, negocios y tecnología) y crecimiento para nuestro cliente. Esto puede incluir: planes estratégicos, reinvención de modelos de negocio, transformación de modelos operativos, efectividad comercial, eficiencia operacional, diseño y ejecución de la transformación integral. 
Desde Business Consulting Transformation para la industria de servicios financieros buscamos ayudar a nuestros clientes de Banking, FinTech, Payment & Insurance a adoptar la transformación de sus negocios en una era tan dinámica y disruptiva como la actual. Colaboramos con la transformación con una visión holística de negocio, personas y tecnología. 
Te proponemos sumarte al equipo de estrategia y transformación para la industria, para junto a equipos talentosos y multidisciplinarios, ayudar a nuestros clientes en la transformación integral que contribuyan a un mejor mundo de negocios, en ámbitos como: 
* Concebir e impulsar una transformación, basada en el conocimiento de la industria e integrando las capacidades existentes dentro de los equipos EY. 
* Diseñar sus negocio, servicios y modelos operativos y diseño de procesos para clientes de la industria bancaria, seguros, pagos y mercado de capitales. 
* Diseñar experiencias de clientes para distintos tipos de negocio.
* Ejecutar la transformación: Participar en programas grandes y complejos que requieren visión integral (personas, tecnología y negocio), disciplina y experiencia especializadas. 
EY trabaja con clientes líderes en toda la región, trabajando para resolver algunos de sus problemas más complejos. Este es el momento perfecto para unirse a un equipo en continuo crecimiento y dejar su huella en la industria de servicios financieros y en la sociedad. 
Responsabilidades
* Diseñar e implementar estrategias de transformación digital en entidades financieras y aseguradoras.
* Liderar proyectos de automatización, modernización tecnológica y digitalización de procesos.
* Analizar tendencias del mercado y proponer soluciones innovadoras alineadas con los objetivos del negocio.
* Colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios para garantizar la entrega de proyectos en tiempo y forma.
* Gestionar la relación con clientes, asegurando altos estándares de calidad y satisfacción.
Requisitos  
* Experiencia de 2 años en proyectos de transformación digital y / o en rediseño de modelos operativos, incluyendo el rediseño del mapa aplicativo. Se valorará experiencia con empresas de servicios financieros o seguros.
* Formación académica en carreras como Negocios Digitales, Tecnología de la Información, Sistemas de Información de las Organizaciones o afines.
* Conocimiento en tecnologías emergentes, metodologías ágiles y herramientas digitales (deseable).
* Habilidades de liderazgo, comunicación efectiva y orientación a resultados.
* Contar con disponibilidad para trabajar full time y con modalidad híbrida.
* Garantizar fluidez en el idioma inglés (oral y escrito).
* Mostrar flexibilidad y adaptación para el trabajo en equipo, la innovación y el aprendizaje.  
¿Qué ofrecemos? 
* Formar parte de una de las mejores empresas para trabajar (GPTW Argentina 2026). 
* Formar parte de un equipo de trabajo altamente reconocido en el mercado y basado en las mejores prácticas. 
* Modalidad de trabajo híbrido. 
* Monto adicional mensual por conectividad/trabajo remoto. 
* Programas de capacitación continua presenciales y virtuales. 
* Plataforma de entrenamiento virtual con más de 18.000 cursos disponibles, entre los cuales se encuentran los cursos de Udemy y Coursera. 
* Acceso a EY Badges, programa global de certificaciones en diferentes áreas de conocimiento. EY Master in Business Analytics y Master in Sustainability, innovadores programas de aprendizaje virtual en asociación con Hult International Business School. 
* Capacitación en idioma inglés: política de clases, open lessons gratuitas, webinars de doble impacto y libre acceso a la plataforma de aprendizaje virtual. 
* Ayuda económica para quienes se mudan a Buenos Aires para trabajar en EY. 
* Cobertura médica privada para vos y tu grupo familiar. 
* Consultorios médicos y nutricionales. Programas anuales de salud. 
* Políticas de flexibilidad, licencias especiales y softlanding para madres recientes. 
* Descuentos en importante red de gimnasios, comercios y universidades. 
* Bono anual. 
* Revisiones salariales periódicas. 
* Snacks gratuitos en la oficina.

Als Teil unseres Performance Improvement-Teams in Frankfurt/Main, Hamburg, Berlin, Düsseldorf, Stuttgart oder München berätst du unsere Kund:innen zu strategischen Fragestellungen rund um die Themen Value Creation, Effizienzsteigerung sowie

keywords: strategy, operating model, M&A, Excel, PowerPoint, value creation
jd_text:
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Du willst mehr als reine Strategieberatung? Du willst tiefer einsteigen als im klassischen M&A? Dann komm dorthin, wo beides zusammenläuft: Bei EY-Parthenon begleitest du CEOs, Vorstände und Private-Equity-Gesellschaften bei transaktionsbasierten Transformationen vom ersten strategischen Gedanken bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Hier arbeitest du an wegweisenden Projekten in vielfältigen Branchen: von der Neuausrichtung und Optimierung von Strategien bis hin zu transformativen Deals und Restrukturierungen. Mit datenbasierten Insights und dem gezielten Einsatz von KI-Technologien eröffnest du neue Märkte, treibst Wachstum voran und entwickelst Unternehmens- und Kapitalstrategien, die den entscheidenden Unterschied machen.
Deine Aufgaben
Als Teil unseres Performance Improvement-Teams in Frankfurt/Main, Hamburg, Berlin, Düsseldorf, Stuttgart oder München berätst du unsere Kund:innen zu strategischen Fragestellungen rund um die Themen Value Creation, Effizienzsteigerung sowie Optimierung des Working Capitals. Dabei übernimmst du vielfältige Aufgaben:
* Du analysierst und bewertest Wertschöpfungsketten und das Operating Model im Rahmen von Unternehmenstransaktionen für unsere nationalen und internationalen Kund:innen.
* Du bereitest finanzielle Analysen sowie operative und Carve-Out-Due-Diligence-Berichte vor, oft als Teil eines dynamischen, multidisziplinären, integrierten Due-Diligence-Teams.
* Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Implementierung von Add-on-Akquisitionen und Carve-outs in Portfoliounternehmen, um deren Wachstumspotenzial zu maximieren.
* Du identifizierst Wertsteigerungspotenziale und hilfst dabei, Maßnahmen abzuleiten sowie umzusetzen, die zur nachhaltigen Effizienzsteigerung von Geschäftsmodellen und Kostenstrukturen beitragen.
* Du arbeitest eng mit deinem Team zusammen, um Herausforderungen zu meistern und dabei deine eigenen Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Dein Skillset
* Du hast dein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Finanzen, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Ingenieurwesen oder anderen quantitativen Studiengängen erfolgreich abgeschlossen und interessierst dich für die Strategie- und Transaktionsberatung.
* Du hast 2-3 Jahre praktische Erfahrungen in der Strategie-, Transaktions- oder der Restrukturierungsberatung gesammelt – alternativ bringst du Strategieentwicklungs- oder erste Transaktionserfahrungen aus der Finanz- oder Corporate-Welt mit und warst auch schon im Ausland tätig.
* Du hinterfragst Fakten kritisch und besitzt sehr gute Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (mind. C1) und Englisch sowie einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office (insbesondere MS Excel und PowerPoint).
Dein Mindset
* Agil: Du bist der Meinung, dass eine flexible Denkweise genauso wichtig für den Erfolg ist wie Wissen und Fähigkeiten.
* Neugierig: Du bist ambitioniert und engagiert. Wir suchen Menschen, die in Chancen und nicht in Herausforderungen denken und durch gezielte Fragen bessere Lösungen finden.
* Teamorientiert: Du schätzt vielfältige Perspektiven und arbeitest gerne im Team. Wir suchen Menschen, die gemeinsam mit uns etwas erreichen und ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen wollen.
Deine Benefits
Bei EY-Parthenon arbeitest du in leistungsstarken, interdisziplinären Teams mit innovativen Technologien. In einem flexiblen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld unterstützen wir dich in deinen unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen. Inspirierende Kolleg:innen sowie Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten on- und off-the-Job helfen dir dabei, über dich hinauszuwachsen und die Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln, die du zukünftig brauchst. Eine steile Lernkurve ist dir garantiert. Mehr über unsere Benefits.
Bewirb dich noch heute!
Mehr Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess bei EY-Parthenon findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.
Was andere über uns sagen, findest du auf kununu und Glassdoor.
Bei EY-Parthenon leben wir Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen. Sag uns gerne frühzeitig Bescheid, wenn wir dich hinsichtlich eines barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozesses unterstützen können.
Du hast noch Fragen? Unser Recruitment Center beantwortet diese gerne unter +49 6196 996 10005.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
Business Consulting – Digital Op Model/Process Improvement and Business Analyst - Customer Transformation – Senior Consultant
General Information
Location: Dublin 
Available for Work Visa Sponsorship: NO
Business Area: Business Consulting - Customer Transformation
Contract Type: Full-Time – Permanent
The Team and the opportunity
This is your chance to join a team that’s transforming how businesses connect with their customers. At EY, our Customer Transformation team helps clients reimagine their customer-facing functions through digital innovation, user-centric design, and agile delivery. You’ll work on exciting projects that shape customer experiences and drive sustainable growth.
Your key responsibilities
* You’ll support the full lifecycle of customer technology projects—from research and business case development to delivery and implementation.
* You’ll gather and prioritise requirements, facilitate workshops, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver customer-centred solutions.
* You’ll also support CRM and omnichannel transformation projects, using data to create personalised customer experiences.
Skills and attributes for success
To qualify for the role, you must have
* You’re analytical, detail-oriented, and a strong communicator.
* You’re comfortable working with CRM platforms like Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics and tools like Microsoft Visio or Azure.
* You thrive in agile environments and enjoy collaborating with diverse teams.
* Your focus is always on delivering value and enhancing customer experience.
Ideally, you will also have
* Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, and agile methodologies.
* Familiarity with Martech, CPQ, and emerging technologies.
* Experience as a Product Owner or Scrum Master is a plus.
What we look for
* We’re looking for someone who’s curious, adaptable, and purpose driven.
* You bring a collaborative mindset and a passion for innovation.
* You’re ready to make an impact and help shape the future of customer transformation.
What working at EY offers 
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive benefits package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs: covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer: 
* Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around. 
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career. 
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you. 
All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include: 
* Pension 
* Discounted health insurance
* Web Doctor – Free unlimited online GP consultations for you and your family 
* The purchase of additional annual leave
* Hybrid Working 
* Free Gym membership
* Travel Pass
* Maternity & Paternity leave
* Bike to work Scheme
* Recognition Awards
* Cash incentives for referrals
* Work Mobile 
* Tech MBA paid by EY
* Wellness rooms available in some offices
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance. 
Career Progression 
* When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one. 
* Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
* As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
* Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
* Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 
* We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees. 
About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
Inclusion & Diversity 
We hold a collective commitment to foster an environment where all differences are valued and respected, practices are equitable and everyone experiences a sense of belonging: Inclusion, diversity, and equity are part of who we are at EY. We believe that the highest-performing teams maximize the power of different perspectives and backgrounds. These teams are both diverse and inclusive and are willing to invite and learn from other perspectives. Our ability to include various viewpoints into our mindsets, behaviours and operations is fundamental to driving innovation, building strong relationships, and delivering the best solutions for our clients. 
We recognise the strength that comes from having a diverse workforce and building a culture where we support all our people to achieve their potential. You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 
As an equal opportunities’ employer, we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. Reasonable accommodations are offered at every stage of our recruitment process. 
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 
To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible. 
IMPORTANT: Where Agency assistance is required, our Talent Team will engage directly with suppliers. CVs / Profiles should not be shared directly with Hiring Managers. Unsolicited CVs / Profiles supplied to EY by Recruitment Agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
EY | Building a better working world 
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Your new job | About your main responsibilities
You will rapidly build a mix of hard and soft skills during projects. You will gain experience creating data-backed analysis and insights, learn what makes software companies tick, hone your ability to craft a compelling narrative and present findings to senior executives, and manage and mentor others on your team. You will have a seat at the table with CEOs and investors, helping these clients make more informed decisions and gaining first-hand insights into how investors and management teams operate and make decisions.
As a senior consultant, you’ll be part of the EY-Parthenon Software Strategy team. In this role, you’ll have the following responsibilities:
* Support the development of business strategies using tools such as market analysis, customer research, macroeconomic forecasting and portfolio optimization.
* Review and manage deal documents to identify critical business issues and risks relating to a proposed transaction.
* Perform technical analysis and translate findings into financial implications, being able to present outcomes to a non-technical audience.
* Support workstreams and teams with planning, reporting and setting up meetings and working sessions.
Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
Your team
The Software Strategy Group (SSG) is the specialized software sector practice within EY-Parthenon, and is uniquely positioned in the intersection of strategy and technology, offering Commercial and Software Strategy services. As an integrated team, we are exposed to the cutting-edge tech market dynamics and engage in truly creative and thought-provoking projects.
Senior consultants are the backbone of our case teams. On any given day, you may conduct market research, interview industry participants, meet with technology company executives, conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis, or participate in client discussions.
What we do
* Product strategy and roadmap: EY-Parthenon teams analyze product roadmaps and provide recommendations to enhance commercial positioning, packaging, and pricing using market and competitive research.
* Technology strategy and roadmap: We help companies build suitable tech strategies and architecture roadmaps to meet growth targets, incorporating internal efforts and new technologies.
* Software development effectiveness: The team assesses software development capacities, talent, and processes, offering actionable recommendations to improve productivity, timeliness, quality, and alignment with corporate strategy
* Product and technology diligence: SSG provides top-tier product and technology diligence, assessing product capabilities, roadmaps, software architecture, technical debt, and associated processes.
* Integrated diligence: EY-Parthenon teams combine product and technology diligence with commercial due diligence, analyzing market segments, competition, purchasing dynamics, and pricing to offer a cohesive view of the target investment's growth potential.
Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.

* Demonstrated interest in the technology industry through start-up experience, internships, coursework, extracurricular activities, or research and writing on the subject.
* Ability to make detailed assessments of software products, markets, competitors and customers by using research tooling and market information.
* Excellent problem solving, project coordination, facilitation and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to multitask and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
* Effective organization and time management skills with ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines.
* Proficient in the English language, including the ability to listen, understand, read and communicate effectively, both in writing and verbally, in a professional environment. Dutch language skills are not a prerequisite but are appreciated.
* Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary (approximately 0-20%).
* A passion for technology!
