* A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
* You’ll receive a full-time (40 hours) fixed contract for the duration of 1 year, with the intent to convert this into a permanent contract.
* A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
* 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind.
* With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
* At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
* The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
* The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
* You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
* Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
* A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here.
Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process
For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.
Our first contact: After your application, our recruiter will call you within 10 days for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match.
Assessment: Before your interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences.
Interviews: We’ll discuss the results of your assessment during the first interview, which will include a colleague from the relevant department. This mutual introduction is a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to ask any questions you have. If we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview where we’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. A business case is also part of the process.
We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY!
Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.

At PwC, Štěpán’s mission is to build a strong senior team capable of delivering impactful solutions on international projects and using cutting‑edge technologies. 
In his free time, he teaches diving, combining discipline, calm leadership, and a passion for helping others grow — both underwater and in professional life. 
Job description & summary
We are looking for a Business Consultant to join our Document Automation team in Prague. The opportunity
You’ll join our Sustainability team and work on projects focused on the Financial Services sector, including banking, insurance and other financial institutions.
You’ll support clients in understanding sustainability and ESG topics relevant to financial sector, identifying related risks and opportunities and integrating sustainability into their business, risk management and decision-making processes.

* Help clients understand and respond to sustainability and ESG-related regulatory requirements.

Today, a company’s value is increasingly reflected not just in its short-term financial performance, but also in its ability to deliver value to multiple stakeholders, including consumers, employees, governments, and wider society. How organisations respond to global challenges such as climate change and sustainability are critical in how they deliver and demonstrate value to stakeholders.
The Opportunity:
In response to this, we are looking for high-performing, innovative and enthusiastic candidates to join our growing team of climate change and sustainability finance professionals who are building a better working world by helping global organisations to identify, measure, deliver and report on the climate and sustainability issues which are most relevant to create long-term value for business. 
Successful candidates will join the EY Financial Service’s Climate Change and Sustainability Services team. Within Climate Change and Sustainability Services (CCaSS), our focus areas are climate change, sustainability assurance and advisory, navigating the regulatory landscape, and creating long term value. There will be opportunities to work across the focus areas within the wider business.
The Role:
This role will place you at the heart of a high-energy, agile team that is committed to helping clients build long-term sustainable businesses. This opportunity will enable you to work with leading financial institutions to deliver better outcomes on some of the world’s most pressing climate and sustainability issues. You will interact with EY colleagues globally and work across our different sectors and business activities.
EY is looking for Senior Consultant Candidates with Auditing, Data & Analytics or Regulatory experience to help our clients respond to issues across the sustainability agenda. Key service areas include:
* Sustainability reporting and assurance.
* Sustainability Data and Implementation.
* Sustainability strategy.
* Climate and Nature change risk.
* Carbon measurement and management.
* ESG advisory.
* Responsible investment.
Your key responsibilities:
You’ll spend most of your time in assisting clients to identify, measure, and manage their business and reporting risks as they transit their organizations in response to changing government environmental regulations and new trends in sustainability management and reporting. You enjoy actively contributing to the growth and development of the CCaSS practice by taking operational responsibility and accountability for engagement team support and delivery.
Skills and attributes for success:
As a Senior Consultant / Assistant Manager within the team, you will be expected to consult, so it is essential that you bring the competencies that will allow you to do so.
* Intellectual curiosity.
* Strong problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills, verbal, written but also active listening.
* Solution orientated including models and accelerators.
* Proven experience acting as an AI enabler, helping translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, scalable solutions within a regulated environment.
* Background in Risk and Regulatory functions, with a strong understanding of compliance, governance, and control frameworks.
* Experience working within or alongside central banks, regulators, or related institutions (e.g., WAM or similar financial/monetary authorities), with insight into supervisory expectations and policy-driven environments.
Qualifications:
We welcome applicants from a wide range of backgrounds, but are particularly interested in individuals that have the following qualifications:
* Track record of success from 2-4 years of relevant experience in sustainability / ESG at a blue-chip firm, sustainability consultancy, investment firm or other relevant organisation.
* ACA or ACCA (or equivalent) qualification.
* A keen interest in, and understanding of ESG as it relates to financial services (banking, wealth and asset management, insurance, and/or private equity).
* A strong understanding of any, or a combination of the topics that we cover in our team as listed above.
* Risk management and modelling experience.
* Strong academic record including a relevant degree.
* Experience running or contributing to a range of projects.
What we look for
We’re interested in leaders with a genuine creative vision and the confidence to make it happen. You can expect plenty of autonomy in this role, so you’ll also need the ability to take initiative and seek out opportunities to improve our current relationships and processes.
What working at EY offers 
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive benefits package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs: covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer: 
* Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues around. 
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career. 
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you. 
All our employees are given a benefits package which they can tailor to suit their individual preferences. Our range of benefits include: 
* Pension 
* Discounted health insurance
* Web Doctor – Free unlimited online GP consultations for you and your family 
* The purchase of additional annual leave
* Hybrid Working 
* Free Gym membership
* Travel Pass
* Maternity & Paternity leave
* Bike to work Scheme
* Recognition Awards
* Cash incentives for referrals
* Work Mobile 
* Tech MBA paid by EY
* Wellness rooms available in some offices
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance. 
Career Progression 
* When you join EY, you will be supported to ensure that you are enhancing your skills from day one. 
* Continuous learning, where you can develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next. 
* As you grow and develop here, you’ll discover opportunities to help customise your career journey, so that it’s as unique as you are - success is defined by you, we will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way. 
* Transformative leadership, we will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs. 
* Diverse and inclusive culture, you will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs. 
* We have embraced Hybrid working at EY adding greater flexibility and autonomy to the roles of our employees. 
About EY
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
Inclusion & Diversity 
We hold a collective commitment to foster an environment where all differences are valued and respected, practices are equitable and everyone experiences a sense of belonging: Inclusion, diversity, and equity are part of who we are at EY. We believe that the highest-performing teams maximize the power of different perspectives and backgrounds. These teams are both diverse and inclusive and are willing to invite and learn from other perspectives. Our ability to include various viewpoints into our mindsets, behaviours and operations is fundamental to driving innovation, building strong relationships, and delivering the best solutions for our clients.

jd_text:
EY-Parthenon est un des leaders mondiaux du conseil de direction générale en matière de stratégie, de transformation et de transaction. Nous réunissons 25 000 consultants à travers le monde, intégrés à notre réseau de 400 000 professionnels EY dans 150 pays. De la conception à l’exécution de vos stratégies et de vos transactions, EY-Parthenon vous aide à redéfinir votre futur.
Nos équipes apportent un éclairage extérieur et des savoir-faire précis, combinant des expertises multisectorielles et multidisciplinaires approfondies, avec des capacités de pointe en matière d'analyse de données, d'IA et de technologie.
Nous accompagnons ainsi les directions générales et leur comité de direction, les conseils d'administration, les fonds d'investissement et les gouvernements à chaque étape de leurs réflexions et de leurs prises de décision, pour les aider à façonner leur avenir en toute confiance.
Vous cherchez de nouvelles opportunités professionnelles et êtes attirés par le conseil en transaction ? L’équipe TSE (Transaction, Strategy & Execution) d’EY-Parthenon recrute pour son bureau parisien. Nous accompagnons nos clients pour maximiser la valeur dans le cadre d’acquisitions, cessions ou de retournement.
L’opportunité :
Nous conseillons nos clients (Corporate, fonds d’investissement, institutionnels) sur des transactions de premier plan. Notre équipe de professionnels issus de divers secteurs dispose d'une forte expérience en M&A, nous permettant d'apporter à nos clients une expertise sectorielle et opérationnelle reconnue sur le marché
Notre offre de service est structurée de la façon suivante : 
• Buy & Integrate : nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs opérations d’acquisition en apportant une expertise approfondie sur les volets IT et technologiques, incluant le design de modèles opérationnels cibles, l’évaluation de la préparation au Day-1, l’identification et le chiffrage des synergies, ainsi que la définition et l’exécution de la stratégie d’intégration post-fusion (PMI). Nous réalisons également des due diligences IT à l’achat afin d’évaluer les performances passées et actuelles de la cible, d’identifier les risques IT, et d’estimer les opportunités de création de valeur.
• Sell & Separate : nous accompagnons nos clients dans leurs opérations de cession en apportant une expertise IT et technologique, notamment à travers la définition du modèle opérationnel cible au Day-1, l’identification et l’évaluation des synergies, ainsi que la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de carve-out IT. Nous réalisons également des due diligences IT à la vente pour présenter les niveaux d’imbrication des systèmes, évaluer les performances IT passées et actuelles, identifier les risques, et valoriser les opportunités de création de valeur.
• Product & Technology Diligence : nous réalisons des missions de diligence produit et technologique pour des entreprises à forte composante logicielle. Cela inclut l’évaluation des capacités produit, des roadmaps, de l’architecture logicielle, de la dette technique, ainsi que de l’organisation et des processus associés aux équipes de développement logiciel.
Notre équipe à Paris - actuellement en phase de forte croissance - recrute des consultants seniors H/F pour continuer à servir au mieux nos clients et soutenir notre ambition actuelle. 
Vos missions :
En tant que membre clé de l’équipe, vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble de nos missions. Vos responsabilités incluront notamment :
• Analyser la documentation transactionnelle et conduire des entretiens afin d’identifier les enjeux et risques critiques liés à l’IT, à la technologie et au business dans le cadre d’une opération envisagée.
• Réaliser des analyses techniques et traduire les résultats en impacts IT et financiers, tout en étant capable de les présenter à un public non technique.
• Contribuer aux projets d’intégration post-fusion (PMI), de carve-out IT, ainsi qu’au design et à la mise en œuvre de modèles opérationnels cibles (Target Operating Models - TOM).
• Encadrer et accompagner les membres Juniors de l’équipe.
Profil recherché :
• Diplômé d’une grande école de commerce ou d’ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en IT, technologies ou management de l’innovation appréciée.
• Minimum de 2 ans d’expérience professionnelle.
• Solides capacités d’analyse et de synthèse.
• Bonne compréhension des concepts IT et intérêt marqué pour les nouvelles technologies.
• Une expérience en transaction, en stratégie IT ou en projets de transformation IT est un plus.
• Capacité d’adaptation aux nouveaux challenges/concepts.
• Capacité et volonté de voyager dans le cadre des missions.
• Maîtrise parfaite du français et de l’anglais. 
L’offre EY-Parthenon :
Vous bénéficierez d’un régime de rémunération et de bonus compétitif, établi sur la base de votre performance et de votre contribution à nos activités. Par ailleurs, EY-Parthenon vous permettra de : 
• Développer de nouvelles compétences et accélérer votre carrière chez un des leaders du conseil en transaction et transformation
• Travailler dans un environnement international, avec de fortes opportunités de mobilité en interne
• Bénéficier de l’accompagnement et du coaching d’une équipe d’experts reconnus sur le marché
Vivez l’expérience EY, Rejoignez-nous !
Dans le cadre de sa politique Diversité, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

Job Description & Summary
PwC Österreich ist mit rund 1.500 Mitarbeitenden an 6 Standorten eines der größten Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmen des Landes. Wir setzen auf Menschen, die frische Perspektiven einbringen und aus neuen Ideen echte Erfolge machen. Starte jetzt deinen Weg.
KI-Agenten verändern, wie Unternehmen Kund:innen gewinnen, begleiten und binden. Die Gewinner werden nicht die sein, die am meisten automatisieren. Es werden die sein, die Technologie und menschliche Stärken am besten verbinden. In unserem Team Customer Transformation begleiten wir führende Unternehmen auf diesem Weg. Wir bauen kundennahe Wertströme in Marketing, Vertrieb und Service end-to-end neu auf: von der Strategie über das Zielbild bis zur Umsetzung.
Dabei erleben wir gerade einen grundlegenden Shift. CRM-Plattformen öffnen sich nach dem Headless-Prinzip, Frontends werden entkoppelt. Die Customer Journey findet zunehmend dort statt, wo Menschen ohnehin arbeiten und fragen: in KI-Assistenten und Agenten-Plattformen wie Claude oder ChatGPT. Deshalb arbeiten wir technologieoffen: Im Mittelpunkt steht der Nutzen für unsere Kund:innen, nicht das Tool. Unser Partner-Ökosystem wächst laufend.
Bei uns bist du nicht nur Teil eines Projekts. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für ein Thema und treibst es voran.
Deine Aufgaben bei uns im Team
* Gestalte gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen die Transformation zum Agentic Enterprise in Marketing, Sales und Service 
* Begleite unsere Kund:innen beim Wandel hin zu Headless- und agentischen Architekturen und arbeite an zukunftsfähigen Customer Journeys 
* Entwickle Zielbilder, Use Cases und Roadmaps und übersetze komplexe Fragestellungen in klare Konzepte und greifbare Business Cases 
* Übernimm Verantwortung von der Kundenakquise über die Angebotserstellung bis zur erfolgreichen Projektdurchführung 
* Konzipiere und moderiere Workshops mit Fachbereichen, IT und Management und begeistere Stakeholder bis auf Entscheider-Ebene für neue Wege 
* Verbinde Business und Technologie, bewerte Technologie-Optionen unabhängig und begleite die konzeptionelle Gestaltung und Umsetzung agentischer Lösungen 
* Unterstütze unsere Kund:innen bei Change, Adoption und Governance, damit die Transformation im Alltag ankommt 
* Treibe Themen aktiv voran und entwickle unser Leistungsportfolio und Partner-Ökosystem rund um Agentic Enterprise gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter
Das spricht dich an? Dann freuen wir uns, wenn du folgende Skills und Eigenschaften mitbringst:
* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft, Informatik, Technik, Kommunikation, Psychologie, Sozialwissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im relevanten Umfeld 
* Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der Beratung, mit Bezug zu Marketing, Sales, Service, CRM oder Customer Experience 
* Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer relevanten Technologie und Neugier auf die anderen, zum Beispiel: * KI-Modelle & Agenten-Plattformen: z. B. Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI / ChatGPT, Google Cloud (Gemini, Vertex AI), AWS (z. B. Amazon Bedrock) 
* CRM- & Customer-Plattformen: z. B. Salesforce inkl. Agentforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365 / Copilot Studio 
* Spezialisierte KI-Lösungen: z. B. Voice-AI und KI-Telefonie (etwa fonio) 
* Von Vorteil: Verständnis für Konzepte wie Headless-Architekturen, Agent-Orchestrierung, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Datenanbindung (Grounding) oder AI-Governance sowie passende Zertifizierungen 
* Proaktive, technologieoffene und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Freude daran, komplexe Themen klar zu strukturieren, verständlich aufzubereiten und sich rasch in neue Plattformen einzuarbeiten 
* Professionelle Kommunikationsstärke, ausgeprägtes Gespür für Stakeholder sowie hohe Eigenverantwortung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, Teams und Organisationen im Transformationsumfeld 
* Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 
Du bringst nicht alle angeführten Punkte mit? Kein Problem! Nicht jede:r Bewerber:in muss alle Kriterien erfüllen, wir investieren gerne in deine Fähigkeiten!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung in Form eines Anschreibens sowie deines Lebenslaufes. Zeugnisse und Zertifikate sind auch gern gesehen.

Our professionals are highly qualified and trained, with deep industry knowledge and a global presence. 
Join EY Indonesia’s CCaSS to be a member of a multidisciplinary team working to empower clients in understanding and managing their environmental and social impacts, as well as the risks and opportunities arising from climate change and sustainability issues. As part of our team, you can take part in both advisory and assurance engagements, both enabling institutional progress in sustainability and ensuring the integrity of critical sustainability-related information. Our services span climate and decarbonization, sustainability, environment, health and safety (EHS), as well as sustainability reporting and assurance. 
Your key responsibilities
You’ll spend most of your time assisting clients to identify, measure, and manage impact, risks, and opportunities as they transition their organizations in alignment with global and national climate ambitions. You will also actively contribute to the growth and development of the CCaSS practice by taking operational responsibility and accountability for engagement team support and delivery.

* Assisting, analyzing, and conducting customized research to support clients in sustainability/ESG transformation, decarbonization, climate change risks and opportunities, EHS, sustainability reporting and other related services.

* Assisting clients in enhancing their sustainability reporting through materiality assessments, gap assessments against applicable reporting standards and frameworks, benchmarking analyses, and recommendations to strengthen reporting processes, governance, risk management, and internal controls.

* Supporting client relationships, business development activities, and account management initiatives through the development of thought leadership, client and internal materials, as well as training.

Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our people in operations consulting specialise in providing consulting services on optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. These individuals analyse client needs, develop operational strategies, and offer guidance and support to help clients streamline processes, improve productivity, and drive business performance.
As an operations consulting generalist at PwC, you will possess a broad understanding of various aspects of operations consulting. You will provide comprehensive guidance and support to clients in optimising operational efficiency and effectiveness. Working in this area, you will analyse client needs, develop operational solutions, and offer recommendations tailored to specific business requirements.
The Opportunity: 
As a Digital Operations, Senior Associate, unlock your potential and embrace the chance to drive meaningful outcomes that’ll elevate your career. You will work closely with Managers and senior team members to translate planning and readiness questions into analytical outputs that inform decision‑making. The role emphasizes strong analytical execution, clear communication of results, and an interest in how analytics is used in real operational decisions. Your role will include, but isn’t limited to: 
Analytical Problem Solving 
* Support structuring of operational, logistics, and planning challenges as analytical problems under uncertainty. 
* Contribute to analysis of trade‑offs involving capacity, inventory, risk, service levels, and timing. 
* Apply quantitative techniques with appropriate rigor based on guidance from senior team members. 
Applied Modelling & Analysis 
* Build and support quantitative analyses including Supply chain network and flow analysis, Inventory planning under uncertainty, Capacity, throughput, and bottleneck analysis, Scenario and probabilistic analysis using simulation 
* Support model testing, sensitivity analysis, and validation to ensure outputs are reliable and decision‑relevant. 
Technology & Tools 
* Develop and maintain analytics code, models, and supporting documentation. 
* Work with data from multiple systems and sources. 
* Support documentation of business rules, data requirements, process flows, and reporting logic. 
* Tools may include Python, R, and SQL; optimization solvers; simulation libraries; and enterprise or cloud data platforms. 
* Follow governed, auditable analytics and documentation practices. 
Team & Stakeholder Support 
* Work collaboratively within project teams to deliver high‑quality analytical outputs. 
* Support preparation of materials and insights for client discussions. 
* Proactively flag data, modelling, or assumption risks to senior team members. 
* Work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. 
What You'll Bring: 
Your skills, knowledge, and experiences are what set you apart. Here's what we look for:
* Degree in operations, industrial/systems engineering, computer science, or a closely related quantitative field. 
* A minimum of 5 years of experience in a relevant field. 
* Experience applying quantitative or analytical techniques to operations, supply chain, or planning problems in defense, manufacturing, or other asset‑intensive industries. 
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to data quality and assumptions. 
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms, system integration concepts, data architecture, and digital workflow enablement is an asset. 
* Candidates with military experience are encouraged to apply 
* PwC Canada is committed to cultivating an inclusive, hybrid work environment. Exact expectations for your team can be discussed with your interviewer.
Additional Requirements 
* As a requirement, a Security Clearance is mandatory for all staff who’ll be engaged on these assignments. Prior to applying, please review the Government of Canada website to ensure you meet the eligibility requirements to obtain this clearance. This’ll become a condition of your employment with PwC should you receive an offer from us. 
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas for non‑technical audiences. 
This newly created role reflects our commitment to growth and delivering distinctive value for our clients and stakeholders.
The salary range for this position is $84,700 - $134,700. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.
Why you’ll love PwC 
We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Learn more about our Application Process and Total Rewards Package at:

jd_text:
Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.
At EY-Parthenon, you can be sure that you are making a difference - for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you will have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize or broaden your expertise, you are in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY-Parthenon provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field.
Your new job | About your main responsibilities
As a Senior Consultant in EY-Parthenon’s Strategy and Execution team, you play a key role in helping clients navigate complex transactions and transformations. You work across the full deal lifecycle, covering divestments, integrations, and value creation. In this role, you support decisions that directly impact business performance and long-term value, working with leading corporates and investors on high-impact, often large-scale transactions.
We work end-to-end across the transaction lifecycle. On the sell side, we help clients prepare and separate businesses, from defining the transaction perimeter and designing standalone operating models and costing to executing the carve-out. On the buy side, we work with clients to evaluate (carved-out) acquisition targets, define integration strategies, and realize synergies. Beyond the transaction, we continue to work alongside clients to realize change, challenge status quo, capture synergies, and deliver measurable improvements in performance.
You work directly with clients on carve-outs, integrations, and transformations by structuring complex topics, advising on key decisions, and ensuring plans are translated into tangible results.
In your role, you:
* Lead and execute in-depth analyses on business performance, cost structures, and operations, translating comingled data into clear insights and actionable recommendations
* Structure complex problems and translate them into clear, actionable solutions, guiding workstreams from initial hypothesis through to implementation
* Assess organizational setups and develop robust solutions, including standalone financials, operating model designs, and separation or integration approaches
* Build robust business cases for synergies, cost optimization, and broader value creation opportunities, and support their realization
* Translate strategic priorities into concrete actions and drive their execution to deliver tangible results
* Work closely with clients to guide decision-making, align stakeholders, and maintain momentum in fast-paced, high-impact environments
* Support and develop junior team members through coaching, feedback, and hands-on guidance, helping them grow while ensuring long-term, high-quality delivery
* Collaborate with managers and senior stakeholders to refine hypotheses, challenge thinking, and steer overall project delivery
Your new team | About your colleagues and the office
Your team
In this role, you work on mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures, supporting clients on decisions that materially impact their business. This can range from targeted acquisitions to more complex, large-scale transactions. You operate at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, contributing to topics such as transaction strategy, operational due diligence, value creation, divestitures, and integrations, with a clear focus on delivering tangible outcomes.
You are part of a close-knit team with a shared ambition, while bringing together a variety of backgrounds and perspectives. We work in a collaborative and supportive environment, where you learn from experienced colleagues, receive regular feedback, and have the opportunity to develop yourself quickly.
Your office: Amsterdam
Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe.
Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution
At EY-Parthenon, we are committed to diversity and inclusion, creating an environment where every team member feels valued and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Our values of integrity, respect, and excellence guide us in everything we do. To be successful in this role we typically see: 
* A minimum of 2-3 years relevant M&A experience or corporate transformations, preferably from corporate M&A teams, strategy consulting or big 4 firms 
* A Master’s degree in a Science, Engineering or Business Administration related field 
* Knowledge of and experience with operational aspects of M&A including due diligence, planning, synergies, value creation and / or post close transformation 
* An aptitude for qualitative and quantitative analysis and the ability to link business strategy to performance 
* The ability to lead and communicate effectively with sound reasoning, preferably in client facing roles 
Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment
* A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development).
* You receive a permanent contract for 40 hours.
* A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance.
* 29 vacation days to recharge and unwind.
* With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app.
* At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you are working from the office, at a client, or from home, we make sure you have a well-equipped home office.
* The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad.
* The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones.
* You have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses.
* Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That is why you have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions.
* A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work.
All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it is important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here.
Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process
1. Application: For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible.

* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or Analytics and 2 years of related work experience; or a graduate degree and approximately 18 months of related work experience.

Location: New York, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Hoboken, Houston, McLean, North Carolina, Philadelphia
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Our clients operate in a world where achieving high performance is just as important as the patients they serve. EY’s Life Sciences team advises clients in the Life Sciences sector on setting strategic decisions to address risks impacting their organization’s performance and impacting patient safety.
The opportunity
The Life Sciences Risk Consulting Services team focuses on biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device manufacturers, and the medical technology industry. You will be an integral part of this team helping clients identify, manage, and respond to risks while accelerating performance and maintaining growth. Our team advises clients on aligning risk and business objectives from strategy to execution, and improving coordination of risk activities across the organization for better outcomes. This involves working with life sciences clients to develop business processes, and design and implement systems to effectively manage these areas governed by the FDA and similar regulatory bodies globally:
* Quality Management Systems (including complaint management, CAPAs, deviations, change control, quality audit management, supplier quality management, etc.)
* Regulatory Affairs (regulatory submissions, Health Registration Management, etc.)
* Laboratory Information Management Systems
* Computer Systems Validation (following a GxP system development lifecycle)
In addition, our team also works on projects with clients to manage these Quality business processes for supply chain, manufacturing, commercial operations and R&D. This includes analyzing various cGMP and 21 CFR Part 11 regulations in the Regulatory Compliance area to determine impact on risk exposure.
Your key responsibilities
Your time will be spent supporting client engagement teams to deliver projects in the life sciences domain, including:
* Implementation of QMS, DMS, Safety, LIMS, and RIM systems (e.g. Veeva, Trackwise, EtQ Reliance, Argus, Calyx) in the roles of business process analyst, technical writer, project manager, computer systems validation, and other business / project roles associated with delivery and execution.
* Implementation of validation lifecycle management systems (e.g. ValGenesis, Kneat)
* Design and execution of QMS and Regulatory processes.
* Performing computer systems validation activities as part of a service.
* Performing Quality audits of client processes within the QMS area.
You will also be expected to work on teams to consistently deliver quality client services by demonstrating in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge, and maintaining long-term client relationships.
Full time employment, Travel required up to 40%.
Skills and attributes for success
* Performing large-scale implementations with consistent high quality delivery
* Driving high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget
* Ability to monitor progress, manage risk, and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes
* Staying abreast of current industry trends relevant to the client’s business
* Effectively working on teams with diverse skills and backgrounds
* Fostering an innovative and inclusive team-oriented work environment
* Demonstrating deep technical capabilities and professional knowledge
 To qualify for the role you must have
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Quality Engineering, Manufacturing or a related field and at least three years of related work experience.
* 3+ years of Life Sciences work experience, including working with Life Science regulatory statutes, GxP business processes or system validations, risk management or compliance programs or integration of risk management functions.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Experience in implementing Veeva Vaults (Quality, Clinical, Regulatory, Safety), LIMS, and/or Validation Lifecycle Management Systems
What we look for
We are interested in passionate leaders with strong delivery capability, and a strong desire to stay on top of trends in the life sciences industry. If you have a strong passion for helping businesses drive measurable value while serving patients, then this role is for you.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $93,600 to $154,500. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $112,400 to $175,600. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
* Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
* Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. 
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis. 
For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

EY | Building a better working world
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 
Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen.
Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied.
Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Als data specialist maak je deel uit van het Data & Intelligence-team met een focus op het implementeren van innovatieve Advisory-diensten. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ondersteunen van organisaties bij het verbeteren van hun bedrijfsprocessen, het versterken van hun beheersingsomgeving en het benutten van de waarde van hun data. Dit doen wij door het implementeren van Data Analytics, AI, Automation en samenwerkingsoplossingen.
Met diepgaande expertise op het gebied van data-analyse, procesoptimalisatie en risk & controls-transformatie helpen wij klanten meer transparantie te verkrijgen in hun bedrijfsvoering en beter onderbouwde beslissingen te nemen. Door data uit uiteenlopende bedrijfs- en IT-systemen te extraheren, integreren, valideren en analyseren, leveren wij bruikbare inzichten waarmee organisaties procesinefficiënties kunnen identificeren, governance kunnen versterken, risico's effectiever kunnen beheersen en hun algehele prestaties kunnen verbeteren.
Onze teams werken nauw samen met klanten om belangrijke bedrijfsprocessen te beoordelen en te monitoren, de effectiviteit van beheersmaatregelen te evalueren, opkomende risico's te identificeren en grootschalige transformatie-initiatieven te ondersteunen. Door middel van geavanceerde analysetechnieken en datavisualisaties helpen wij organisaties de stap te zetten van traditionele steekproefgerichte beoordelingen naar een datagedreven aanpak die inzicht biedt in volledige populaties van transacties en activiteiten.
Voor het leveren van deze oplossingen maken wij gebruik van toonaangevende technologieën en analyseplatformen, waaronder Python, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Alteryx, Power BI en andere innovatieve data- en automatiseringstools. Hiermee stellen wij klanten in staat hun processen en beheersingsomgevingen continu te monitoren en duurzame operationele verbeteringen door te voeren.
Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden
* Leiden en uitvoeren van adviesopdrachten gericht op procesoptimalisatie, risicomanagement, interne beheersing en data-analyse.
* Uitvoeren van data-analyses om trends, risico's, control-deficiënties en mogelijkheden voor operationele verbeteringen te identificeren.
* Beoordelen, ontwerpen en verbeteren van bedrijfsprocessen, control frameworks en governance-structuren.
* Ontwikkelen van dashboards, rapportageoplossingen en continuous monitoring-capaciteiten ter ondersteuning van datagedreven besluitvorming.
* Het managen van werkstromen, projectdeliverables en stakeholdercommunicatie om succesvolle projectuitvoering te waarborgen.
* Faciliteren van klantworkshops, uitvoeren van proceswalkthroughs en presenteren van bevindingen en aanbevelingen.
* Coachen van junior teamleden en bijdragen aan methodologieontwikkeling en initiatieven voor continue verbetering.
Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor
Jouw team 
Je komt terecht in het FSO Data & Intelligence team. Ons team bestaat uit een diverse groep professionals met achtergronden in data science, economie en finance, die nauw samenwerkt met financiële auditors binnen EY. Waar auditors zich richten op het uitvoeren van controles, richt ons team zich op het ontwikkelen van slimme, datagedreven oplossingen die processen efficiënter, betrouwbaarder en toekomstbestendig maken. Het team ondersteunt in uiteenlopende opdrachten binnen de financiële sector. 
Jouw kantoor
Amsterdam
Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden maar liefst 1500 mensen per dag bij binnenkomst verwelkomd. Voor een adembenemend uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. Samenwerken krijgt door de Wavespace een nieuwe betekenis. Deze High-Tech omgeving brengt wereldwijd klanten en collega’s virtueel samen.
Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage
* Een bachelor- of masterdiploma in Bedrijfseconomie, Bedrijfskunde, Business Analytics, Informatiemanagement, Accountancy, Informatica, Data Science of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied.
* Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring binnen consulting, internal audit, risk advisory, procesverbetering, interne beheersing, data-analyse of een vergelijkbaar domein.
* Ervaring met het beoordelen van bedrijfsprocessen, risico's en interne beheersmaatregelen.
* Kennis van governance-, risk- en complianceprincipes, IT General Controls (ITGC), IT Application Controls (ITAC) of operationele control frameworks.
* Ervaring met data-analyse- en visualisatietools zoals Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, Python, Tableau of vergelijkbare technologieën.
* Het vermogen om data te interpreteren en inzichten te vertalen naar concrete aanbevelingen.
* Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels.
Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier

Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces 
* 
Voor deze vacature ontvangen we graag alleen je cv. Zo maken we het jou makkelijk om snel te solliciteren.

Ons eerste contact: na jouw sollicitatie belt onze recruiter jou binnen zeven werkdagen voor een korte kennismaking. We verkennen alvast kort over en weer of de functie bij jou zou passen.

US New Ventures, Technology & Innovation | Deloitte Catalyst Silicon Valley | Silicon Valley/Bay Area | Domain Engagement Manager (Senior Consultant)
Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth and Transformation 
Deloitte Catalyst is Deloitte’s global innovation and technology ecosystems program, connecting Deloitte businesses, clients, and leaders with founders, high-potential startups, venture investors, academia, and other external innovators. Catalyst Silicon Valley is a new market-facing hub designed to deepen Deloitte’s engagement in the Silicon Valley / Bay Area ecosystem and translate emerging technology activity into relevant opportunities for Deloitte and its clients.
This founding role sits at the intersection of venture capital, startup innovation, Deloitte market strategy, and client growth. The person in this role will establish the hub’s local presence, manage priority ecosystem relationships, surface market intelligence, and advance qualified opportunities that support Deloitte’s broader growth agenda.
The ideal candidate brings strong tech and innovation fluency, a deep local network, networking skills, an analytical mindset, and the ability to translate emerging technology into practical relevance for Deloitte clients and leaders. This is an opportunity to help define and execute how Catalyst Silicon Valley shows up in market and how future Catalyst hubs activate local innovation ecosystems.
Work You’ll Do
As a Domain Engagement Manager, Senior Consultant, you will: 
* Build and manage relationships with founders, startups, venture investors, accelerators, academia, and ecosystem leaders, increasing Deloitte’s visibility and credibility across the Silicon Valley / Bay Area innovation ecosystem.

jd_text:
The Opportunity: Your Next Adventure Awaits? 
AI is moving from experimentation to enterprise execution. Organisations now need leaders who can connect ambition to architecture, data foundations to deployed products, and emerging technology to measurable business value. At EY Belgium, our Data & AI practice is growing rapidly, and we are investing significantly in the capabilities, talent and propositions that will define our next phase.
We work with leading organisations on Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, data platforms, AI-ready data foundations, AI engineering, data engineering, intelligent operations and responsible adoption. Our work spans strategy, engineering and transformation: from shaping an AI Strategy or Data Strategy to building scalable solutions, modernising Data Architecture and embedding new ways of working.
This is an opportunity to build, not just to manage. As Senior Manager – AI & Data, you will join us at a moment of momentum and help shape what comes next. You will operate at the intersection of business strategy × AI/Data × engineering × leadership—moving comfortably from boardroom discussions and executive workshops to architecture decisions, engineering teams, AI prototypes, transformation roadmaps and commercial conversations.
Your Key Responsibilities
You will lead complex Data & AI engagements from first conversation through implementation and value realisation. You will work directly with C-level and senior stakeholders, structure ambiguous problems, shape transformation roadmaps and turn business priorities into secure, scalable technology solutions.
* Lead with outcomes. Own major AI Transformation, Digital Transformation and Data & AI programmes, keeping business value, adoption, governance and delivery quality in view.
* Shape the answer. Define AI Strategy, Data Strategy, target operating models, transformation roadmaps and investment priorities with senior client leaders.
* Design for scale. Guide AI Architecture, Data Architecture, cloud-native architectures and modern Data Platforms, including integration, APIs, streaming and event-driven patterns.
* Stay close to the build. Oversee—and where relevant contribute to—solution design, prototypes and engineering decisions across Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Machine Learning, MLOps and LLMOps.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams. Bring together AI Engineering, Data Engineering, architecture, product, industry, change and governance specialists; coach them and create the conditions for exceptional work.
* Build trust into delivery. Embed AI Governance, Responsible AI, security, data quality and human oversight without slowing innovation.
* Grow the business. Build trusted client relationships, identify new opportunities, shape compelling proposals and expand our work with existing and new clients.
You will not simply join an established team—you will help shape what we become. Working with the practice leadership, you will turn market signals and delivery experience into differentiated capabilities that clients can understand, buy and scale.
* Create new AI & Data offerings and sharper client propositions.
* Develop reusable accelerators, reference architectures and delivery assets.
* Help shape our forward-deployed AI Engineering model: compact, senior teams working side by side with clients to move rapidly from problem to production.
* Strengthen our AI Engineering and Data Engineering capabilities, standards and communities.
* Recruit exceptional talent and develop consultants, engineers and future leaders.
* Build strategic alliances and activate our technology ecosystem.
* Create thought leadership and support focused go-to-market activity.
* Help set the future direction, investment priorities and market position of the practice.
Your Profile 
You may currently be a Senior Manager AI, Senior Manager Data, AI Consultant, AI Architect, engineering leader or Technology Consulting leader. Titles matter less than the range you can cover: strategy through implementation, client leadership through engineering depth, and delivery through commercial growth.
* Typically 5-8+ years of relevant professional experience in AI, Data, technology consulting or enterprise transformation, including responsibility for complex client engagements and multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong engineering fundamentals and the credibility to challenge architecture, delivery choices and technical trade-offs.
* Practical knowledge across Generative AI and GenAI, Agentic AI, AI Agents, prompt engineering, RAG, AI application development, Machine Learning, MLOps or LLMOps.
* Experience with Data Engineering, Data Architecture, data products, governance, quality, integration, APIs, streaming, data lakes or lakehouses.
* Familiarity with Cloud platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud; Databricks, Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake; and languages such as Python and SQL.
* A strong strategic and commercial mindset: you can link technology choices to value, shape opportunities and earn trust with senior stakeholders.
* Clear, confident communication and the ability to facilitate executive workshops and make complex topics understandable.
* An entrepreneurial drive to build offerings, teams, relationships and market relevance—not only deliver projects.
* Curiosity, humility and the ability to learn rapidly. We value breadth, depth and judgement over a checklist of tools.
* A background in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, Mathematics, Business Engineering or a related discipline can be valuable, but equivalent experience is equally relevant.
* Professional fluency in English is essential; Dutch and/or French is an advantage in the Belgian market.
* We are expanding our work in Industrial Data, IT/OT integration, Smart Factory, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Intelligent Operations. Experience with IoT, Industrial AI, shop-floor data, data contextualisation or digital twins is a strong advantage. It is not a prerequisite; what matters is your ability to understand operational reality and engineer solutions that work beyond the demo.
What’s In It For You 
* EY Family – you become part of the EY Family providing you with all the necessary skills, training and opportunities; enabling you to grow to your fullest potential.
* Attractive remuneration package - We offer an attractive remuneration package; including a company car and charging card, iPhone plus subscription, health insurance, pension plan, meal vouchers, and eco vouchers. Thanks to our flex plan it is possible to choose what you value most. 
* Mobility package - You’ll be able to opt-in for the mobility budget. In return for giving up your (right to a) company car, you’ll receive a monthly budget from EY as compensation. This budget will allow you to use your employer-provided compensation for alternative transportation means or similar benefits, incl. reimbursement of housing costs (on condition you live within 10km of your main place of employment).
* Flexible working arrangements - We are proud of our flexible working arrangements. We will actively support you in building a successful career and delivering excellent client service without sacrificing your personal priorities. We offer flexible working hours and working from home multiple days per week is possible.
* Inspiring work environment - At EY we are dedicated to providing you with an inspiring work environment. A work environment that allows you to further develop your skills and enables you to fulfill your true potential.
* Learning & personal growth - You will benefit from an onboarding program, receive extensive training and will be coached by a counselor. We offer a clear career path tailored to your unique skills with necessary guidance. 
* Fun - By joining our EY- teams, you can participate in team activities, and companywide events and enjoy a drink during our monthly after-work drink. 
* Sustainability - We have a fleet of hybrid and electric cars. Our flex plan makes it possible for you to choose the most sustainable option for you. You can also opt for a train subscription or lease a bike.
* Diversity & Inclusion - At EY we are passionate about the inclusion and support of individuals of all groups; we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.
* Location - All of our offices are easily accessible by public transport and/or by car and have parking space. They all have parking spaces and charging stations are provided.
* Artificial Intelligence – stay up to date with the latest AI trends through our extensive training opportunities and integrated AI systems. You’ll learn how to leverage AI in a smart and efficient way in your day-to-day work, while developing skills to identify, quantify and track value creation when integrating AI into client environments. 
Here at EY, you’ll have the chance to build a truly exceptional experience. We’ll empower you with the latest technology, surround you with high-performing teams, and provide the global scale and diverse and inclusive culture you need to discover your full potential. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skillsets you need to stay relevant today and in the future – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.

Job description
Connect to your Industry
Do you want to contribute to some of the UK’s most significant and ambitious digital programmes, helping our clients deliver outcomes that support national security?
We are proud of the impact we have with our Defence & Security clients, the strength of our relationships, and the variety of our skills and expertise that we bring to help them achieve their mission.
We’re growing our teams across all of Technology and Transformation. If you are cleared to SC or DV level and want to grow your career in this sector, we are very keen to hear from you.
Connect to your career at Deloitte
Deloitte drives progress. Using our vast range of expertise, we help our clients' become leaders wherever they choose to compete. To do this, we invest in outstanding people. We build teams of future thinkers, with diverse talents and backgrounds, and empower them all to reach for and achieve more.
What brings us all together at Deloitte? It’s how we approach the thousands of decisions we make every day. How we behave, our beliefs and our attitudes. In other words: our values. Whatever we do, wherever we are in the world, we lead the way, serve with integrity, take care of each other, foster inclusion, and collaborate for measurable impact. These five shared values lead every decision we make and action we take, guiding us to deliver impact how and where it matters most.
Connect to your opportunity
Are you passionate about building your career in complex, technology-enabled transformation programmes?
Our clients operate in an environment shaped by increasing complexity, rapid technological change and evolving social and economic challenges. They need multidisciplinary teams that combine clear thinking, effective delivery governance and human-centred, technology-enabled change to deliver outcomes with confidence.
Within Deloitte’s Human Capital practice, you will work as part of multidisciplinary teams supporting some of the most important and demanding programmes in Defence, Security and Justice. These programmes often sit at the intersection of operating model change, workforce transformation, digital capability, and large-scale technical delivery and adoption.
You will support the design and delivery of complex engagements, taking responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables with guidance from more experienced colleagues. You will work closely with clients and multidisciplinary teams, build your understanding of delivery challenges and contribute practical ideas and high-quality outputs. As your capability develops, you may take ownership of broader deliverables or coordinate specific activities. You will build your skills in programme delivery, client engagement and technology-enabled transformation using Deloitte’s methods, tools and global capabilities.
Major Programmes Communities
Within Major Programmes, you’ll focus on working with clients across the South and South West of England.
Your role will allow you to:
* Work alongside engineering and digital delivery teams, developing experience in areas such as product management, Scrum Master, DevOps or related delivery approaches.
* Support effective project, programme or portfolio governance by producing accurate delivery artefacts, including plans, change information and workshop outputs.
* Contribute to digital transformation engagements through activities such as operating model design and implementation, business analysis and scaled agile delivery.
* Support PMO and programme controls activities, including progress reporting, financial tracking, planning, RAID management, and data analysis and visualisation.
* Contribute to the mobilisation and delivery of large-scale technology-enabled transformations, including programme setup, governance and delivery planning.
* Gather and analyse information on programme performance across scope, budget, risk, dependencies and outcomes, highlighting issues and supporting clear reporting.
* Take responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables, working with business, technical and delivery colleagues to complete them to a high standard.
* Build confidence working with clients, contribute effectively to meetings and support proposals and other business-development activities.
* Share practical insight, reusable materials and lessons learned to support our propositions, delivery methods and industry perspectives.
Connect to your skills and professional experience
All applicants must hold UK security clearance for a minimum of SC level.
Essential:
* Some practical experience of contributing to technology-enabled projects, programmes or transformation initiatives, gained in a professional, academic or comparable setting.
* An interest in the Defence or Security environment and the ability to develop relevant sector knowledge quickly.
* Ability to take responsibility for defined tasks and deliverables, seek guidance when needed and produce accurate, high-quality outputs.
* Awareness of, or experience applying, at least one relevant delivery capability, such as project or programme management, PMO, business analysis, agile delivery, product management or engineering delivery.
* Ability to communicate clearly with colleagues, clients and stakeholders, adapting your style to the audience and contributing confidently to discussions.
* Good problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify relevant information, recognise delivery risks or issues and present clear findings.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, respond positively to feedback and contribute to shared outcomes in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to organise your own work, manage priorities and adapt when requirements or delivery conditions change.
* An interest in developing commercial awareness, including an understanding of delivery constraints, financial considerations, suppliers and how proposals support client relationships.
Connect to your business - Technology and Transformation
Distinctive thinking, deep expertise, innovation and collaborative working. That’s what connects us. That’s what makes us Deloitte. If you want to help solve some of the biggest tech and transformational challenges around, join us. Together, we’ll make an impact that matters.
Human Capital
People are what powers enterprise. That’s why we need to focus on the human experience in an ever-changing, digital world. We help clients utilise technology to support their workforce, organisation, and HR Transformations.
Personal independence
Regulation and controls are standard practice in our industry and Deloitte is no exception. These controls provide important legal protection for both you and the firm. We are subject to a number of audit regulations, one of which requires that certain colleagues abide by specific personal independence constraints (e.g., in relation to any financial interests and employment relationships). This can mean that you and your "Immediate Family Members" are not permitted to hold certain financial interests (shares, funds, bonds etc.) with audit clients of the firm, and also prohibitions on certain employment relationships (e.g., you are not permitted to hold a secondary employment role with SEC audit clients of the firm whilst being employed by the firm). The recruitment team will provide further detail as you progress through the recruitment process or you can contact the Independence team upon request.
Connect with your colleagues
“The great culture, flexibility, and range of experiences that Deloitte offers are what sets this firm apart. In Human Capital, Deloitte is far ahead of any of our immediate competitors.” - Sophia, Technology & Transformation.
Our hybrid working policy
You’ll be based in Bristol with hybrid working.
At Deloitte we understand the importance of balancing your career alongside your home life. That’s why we’ll support you to work flexibly through our hybrid working policy. Depending on the requirements of your role, you’ll have the opportunity to work in your local office, virtual collaboration spaces, client sites and remotely. You’ll get the chance to meet face to face when needed, while you collaborate and learn from colleagues, share your experiences, and build the relationships that will fuel your career and prioritise your wellbeing. Please check with your recruiter for the specific working requirements that may apply for your role.
Our commitment to you
Making an impact is more than just what we do: it’s why we’re here. So we work hard to create an environment where you can experience a purpose you believe in, the freedom to be you, and the capacity to go further than ever before.
We want you. The true you. Your own strengths, perspective and personality. So we’re nurturing a culture where everyone belongs, feels supported and heard, and is empowered to make a valuable, personal contribution. You can be sure we’ll take your wellbeing seriously, too. Because it’s only when you’re comfortable and at your best that you can make the kind of impact you, and we, live for.
Your expertise is our capability, so we’ll make sure it never stops growing. Whether it’s from the complex work you do, or the people you collaborate with, you’ll learn every day. Through world-class development, you’ll gain invaluable technical and personal skills. Whatever your level, you’ll learn how to lead.
Connect to your next step
A career at Deloitte is an opportunity to develop in any direction you choose. Join us and you’ll experience a purpose you can believe in and an impact you can see. You’ll be free to bring your true self to work every day. And you’ll never stop growing, whatever your level.
Discover more reasons to connect with us, our people and purpose-driven culture at deloitte.co.uk/careers

We’re a team that transforms vision into tech-enabled reality. We look for those who see technology not just as tools or platforms, but as the invisible infrastructure behind strategy, performance, and growth. We turn bold ideas into scalable, secure, and human-centered solutions.    
SHAPING TOMORROW   
Make a real impact, today, and tomorrow, through work that matters. Here, you will tackle today’s toughest challenges with a future-focused mindset; so our clients turn to us first when it matters most.  
Make a real impact   
In this dynamic environment, we are looking for an ambitious and self-driven Senior Technology Strategy Consultant to join our Tech Advisory team in Athens.    
* Support the development of Technology Strategies and IT / Cloud Transformation programmes aligned with business objectives 
* Assess technology options, perform analyses, and contribute to digital transformation initiatives
* Contribute to the design of Technology Operating Models, Solution Architectures, and Application Landscapes
* Participate in IT Due Diligence and Post-Merger Integration (PMI) engagements, identifying risks and integration opportunities 
* Conduct cost-benefit analyses and business case assessments for technology initiatives
* Support project delivery through stakeholder collaboration, workshops, assessments, and recommendation development
* Contribute to business development activities, including proposals, client presentations, playbooks, and thought leadership assets
* Stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends to support client engagements and innovation initiatives
What you bring matters   
* University degree in Computer Science / Engineering or other relevant fields, advanced degrees (MBA, and/or other Master’s Degree) viewed favourably
* Relevant Experience working with customers on IT / Digital transformation projects
* Good understanding of recent technologic advancements and emerging technologies (e.g. Cloud, AI/ GenAI, Drones etc.). 
* Experience with cloud computing and/or cloud adoption/transformation
* Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, with proven ability to develop high-quality, executive-level presentations that translate complex business and technology topics into clear and compelling messages
* Ability to translate emerging technologies into business opportunities, define strategic roadmaps and use cases, and support their progression from concept through implementation
* Proven track record of executing high-impact projects in cross industry practices (e.g. Financial Services, Consumer Industrial Products and Services, Public Sector & Health Care, Energy & Utilities) from a consulting point of view
* Clear and concise spoken and written communication style tailored to each specific audience. Ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences
BRING YOUR BEST, EVERYDAY  
Your skills, integrity, and curiosity make the difference. At PwC Greece, we match that with an environment that brings out your best every day – supported by people who inspire, challenge, and grow with you.    
What we offer goes beyond a competitive package. It’s about creating the conditions for you to learn, belong, and deliver impact. That means:   
* Your work life-balance supported by a hybrid working model   
* Your creativity sparked in collaborative office spaces   
* Your career growing through local and global opportunities   
* Your development advanced with continuous learning and professional certifications  
* Your well-being cared for with extra leave days and wellness initiatives  
* Your perspective valued in an inclusive team where your impact matters  
Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? At PwC Greece, you lead by example. Our standards for quality and care are high – and together we surpass them. We redefine possibilities for our clients and communities.  
Challenge accepted?  
Our circle of connection matters - it’s at the heart of what we do. Click here (PwC life)  
All applicants will be acknowledged and treated in the strictest confidence.
