jd_text:
Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.
 Work You’ll Do
As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team, you will be responsible for supporting supply chain risk management strategy, governance, and guidebook development for government clients.
* Provide strategic advisory services aligned to established supply chain risk management leading practices.
* Lead the annual update cycle for an enterprise supply chain risk management guidebook, incorporating changes to frameworks, policies, and stakeholder requirements.
* Facilitate senior-level working groups and coordinate input across multiple organizations, business units, and stakeholder groups.
* Manage comments resolution and feedback adjudication processes to support enterprise review and governance activities.
* Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to align supply chain risk management activities with broader defense and government standards.
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others
 The Team
Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.
Our Supply Chain & Network Operations offering advises, implements, and operates transformational solutions that bring world class supply network capabilities.
 Qualifications
Required: 
* Bachelor’s degree 
* 5+ years of experience in supply chain risk management, supply chain strategy, or operational risk management
* 4+ years of experience with National Institute of Standards and Technology Risk Management Framework and supply chain risk management frameworks
* 4+ years of experience authoring technical documentation, guidebooks, policies, or governance materials
* 4+ years of experience facilitating working sessions and providing policy analysis and advisory support across stakeholder groups
* Active Secret Clearance
* Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
* Ability to travel onsite 5 days a week in Cincinnati, OH
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
Preferred: 
* 5+ years of experience supporting defense, federal, or large public sector organizations
* 5+ years of experience with International Organization for Standardization 31000 or National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800-161
* 5+ years of experience supporting comments resolution, governance reviews, or enterprise policy adjudication processes
* 5+ years of experience developing executive-ready deliverables for senior government stakeholders
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $184,500.
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jd_text:
Management Level
Senior Associate
Job Description & Summary
At PwC, our people in workforce consulting focus on providing consulting services related to human resources, talent management, and organisational development. They analyse client needs, develop people and organisation strategies. These individuals offer guidance and support to help clients optimise their workforce, enhance employee engagement, and drive organisational effectiveness.
In HR transformation and technology at PwC, you will focus on providing consulting services related to the overall effectiveness and efficiency of the HR function and related technologies within organisations. You will work closely with clients to assess HR processes, policies, and systems, and provide guidance on HR transformation, technology implementation, and service delivery models. Your work will involve assisting clients in optimising their HR function to align with business objectives and enhance HR service quality.
Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. Navigating increasingly complex situations, you are growing your personal brand, deepening technical expertise and awareness of your strengths. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, and to deliver quality. Embracing increased ambiguity, you are comfortable when the path forward isn’t clear, you ask questions, and you use these moments as opportunities to grow.
Examples of the skills, knowledge, and experiences you need to lead and deliver value at this level include but are not limited to:
* Respond effectively to the diverse perspectives, needs, and feelings of others.
* Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.
* Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.
* Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.
* Develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing.
* Use reflection to develop self awareness, enhance strengths and address development areas.
* Interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.
* Uphold and reinforce professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), the Firm's code of conduct, and independence requirements.
Role Purpose 
The Workforce Transformation Senior Associate supports HR and workforce transformation engagements for clients, working within multidisciplinary teams and a blended delivery model. The role contributes to initiatives across the HR function and the broader workforce – including HRIS implementation, HR process optimisation, organisational change and adoption, strategic workforce planning support, reward, culture change, learning and development, and operating model and organisation design activities. 
Workforce Transformation in this context includes HR function optimisation as well as wider workforce strategy, analytics and operating model changes across employees, contingent workers and digitally enabled (AI/automation) ways of working. 
The Senior Associate focuses on analysis, documentation, and preparation of high‑quality deliverables, helping to embed digital and AI‑enabled ways of working into HR and workforce processes, and providing robust insight and support to managers and senior stakeholders. 
Key Responsibilities 
* Supporting teams in delivering programmes across the following Workforce capability areas: Organisational change and adoption, HR process/technology implementation, strategic workforce planning, operating model and organisation design, reward and recognition, culture, and learning and development. 
* Supporting the delivery of end-to-end projects against agreed timelines and quality standards, from design through to implementation, working closely with client stakeholders and other PwC team members.  
* Assisting in scoping, planning and delivery of client deliverables, working alongside other workstreams such as technology, process, and system design. 
* Supporting client interviews, workshops, and analysis of client documents and data to help develop a clear understanding of current state and future development. 
* Supporting business development activities to help identify and research opportunities on new/existing clients 
* Contributing to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages wellbeing, innovation and knowledge sharing. 
* Using and configuring digital tools where appropriate to support programme delivery and improve efficiency. 
* Using AI tools to enhance the delivery and quality of client engagements. 
* Supporting basic project management activities on Workforce engagements including the development and monitoring of project plans, RAID logs, status updates etc. 
Required Experience, Qualifications and Skills 
Experience 
* Typically 5+ years of experience in consulting or complex corporate environments, with involvement in HR and workforce transformation projects. 
* Proven track record of delivering end‑to‑end projects across Workforce capability areas (e.g. Organisational change and adoption, HR process/technology implementation, strategic workforce planning, operating model and organisation design, reward and recognition, culture, and learning and development.). 
* Experience working in multi‑disciplinary teams and, ideally, global or multi‑country programmes. 
Education and qualifications 
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Organisational Development or a related discipline. 
* Advantageous: Postgraduate qualification; project management / Agile training 
Skills 
* Good understanding of change management concepts and HR processes across the HR value chain. 
* Basic workforce analytics and use of data to support decision‑making. 
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, basic Power BI, collaboration tools and survey tools. 
* Comfort using AI‑enabled productivity tools. 
Travel Requirements
Up to 20%

jd_text:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. 
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
Senior Consultant – Organisational Change
The opportunity
As a Senior Consultant in Organisational Change, you’ll design and deliver change initiatives and workstreams across complex government transformations. Working across the implementation of new technologies, platforms, operating models and ways of working, you’ll bring together people, process, policy, technology and experience to support confident adoption and sustained change.
You will work within diverse teams to deliver large-scale and complex change with our public sector clients, while having access to EY’s global change management methodologies, human-centred global research, and delivering alongside our digital platform partners.
This is a hybrid position based in Canberra - Ngambri.
Our roles can potentially be adjusted to work flexibly with reduced hours. Please speak with us about options.
Your key responsibilities
* Own and deliver defined change workstreams across complex government transformations, contributing to change strategies, roadmaps and end-to-end change journeys.
* Translate organisational strategy into practical change delivery, conducting change impact, stakeholder and readiness assessments and developing targeted interventions to support readiness and adoption.
* Deliver change across people, process, policy, technology and experience, including stakeholder engagement, communications, capability uplift and transition planning.
* Facilitate client and stakeholder discussions and workshops, navigating ambiguity, synthesising complex information and translating insights into practical recommendations and change actions.
* Develop clear change narratives and communications that help stakeholders understand, navigate, advocate for and implement change, while supporting junior team members to deliver high-quality client outcomes.
Skills and attributes for success
* Australian citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government security clearance through the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency (AGSVA).
* Demonstrated experience delivering consulting or change management services within Australian Government environments.
* Experience delivering change workstreams as part of complex transformations, including operating model, workforce, process or system change.
* Strong consulting capability, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, develop practical recommendations and communicate confidently with government stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills, including the ability to conduct workshops and translate complex information into clear actions and recommendations.
* We are particularly interested in hearing from professionals who hold accreditation and/or qualifications in change management, organisational psychology, strategic communications or behavioural science.
Ideally, you’ll also have the skills and attributes below but don’t worry if you don’t tick all the boxes. We’re interested in your aptitude, attitude and willingness to learn.
* Experience delivering change activities across multiple workstreams, including change impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, readiness and practical interventions.
* Ability to integrate people, process, policy, technology and organisational design when developing change solutions.
* Experience developing clear and compelling change narratives and communications for diverse audiences.
* Experience in organisation and workforce design, capability uplift, transition planning, human-centred design or behavioural change approaches.
What we offer you
At EY, we’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. We’re proud to be recognised as the #1 WORK180 Endorsed Employer in the Top 101 Employers for Women 2026. Learn more.

* A comprehensive benefits package: From a yearly wellness incentive, to access to additional 8 weeks of flex leave per year, and family-friendly policies, including up to 26 weeks of gender-neutral paid parental leave, we cater to your diverse needs to help you thrive both personally and professionally www.ey.com/au/benefits

jd_text:
Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen. 
Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied. 
Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Als Senior Consultant Leiderschap & Organisatietransformatie maak je deel uit van het People Consulting team. 
In deze rol help je organisaties bij complexe verander- en transformatievraagstukken. Je combineert expertise op het gebied van leiderschap, verandermanagement, cultuur en organisatieontwikkeling om duurzame verandering te realiseren. 
* 
Technische vaardigheden op het gebied van leiderschap, verandermanagement, en organisatieontwikkeling toepassen om teams en organisaties te begeleiden tijdens complexe transformaties, reorganisaties en verandertrajecten. 
* 
Het analyseren en beoordelen van organisatievraagstukken op het gebied van leiderschap, cultuur, gedrag en verandering en deze vertalen naar concrete interventies. 
* 
Het ontwerpen, voorbereiden en faciliteren van workshops bij klanten; denk aan leiderschapsteams, managementteams en andere belangrijke stakeholders binnen verander- en transformatieprogramma's. 
* 
Verbinding zoeken met je klanten, en het proactief onderhouden en opbouwen van duurzame relaties. Je ziet en benut commerciële kansen. 
* 
Zorgen voor draagvlak bij senior stakeholders voor impactvolle veranderinitiatieven en het ondersteunen van leiders bij het succesvol realiseren van transformaties. 
* 
Bijdragen aan het continu verbeteren en ontwikkelen van onze producten en diensten, met name op het gebied van teamdynamiek, leiderschap, cultuurontwikkeling en organisatietransformatie. 
Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor 
Jouw team 
De afdeling People Consulting bestaat uit 40 HR- en verandermanagementprofessionals die ten minste één ding gemeen hebben; We hebben een mensgerichte mindset en plaatsen de mens centraal in onze opdrachten om een blijvende impact voor onze klanten te maken. We werken nauw samen over onze competenties heen om duurzame resultaten voor de klant te realiseren. De competenties binnen ons team zijn Change Experience, HR Transformation, Leadership & Culture, Digital HR, Talent & Skills, Organization & Workforce Transformation & AI Adoption. 
Jouw expertise speelt een sleutelrol in het verder uitbouwen van onze proposities op het gebied van leiderschap, verandermanagement en organisatietransformatie. Als Senior Consultant Leiderschap en organisatietransformatie help je organisaties bij het ontwikkelen van sterk leiderschap en effectieve leiderschapsteams, begeleid je cultuurverandering tijdens transformaties en ondersteun je teams om duurzaam op hoog niveau te presteren. Je komt terecht in een team met diverse achtergronden, waaronder topsport en defensie. 
Jouw kantoor 
Amsterdam 
Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden maar liefst 1500 mensen per dag bij binnenkomst verwelkomd. Voor een adembenemend uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. Samenwerken krijgt door de Wavespace een nieuwe betekenis. Deze High-Tech omgeving brengt wereldwijd klanten en collega’s virtueel samen. 
Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage 
* 
Heeft bij voorkeur een relevante masteropleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Organisatiepsychologie, Bedrijfskunde, HR of Verandermanagement. 
* 
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring in consulting, verandermanagement, organisatietransformatie of leiderschapsontwikkeling. 
* 
Sterke expertise op het gebied van leiderschap, organisatieverandering, cultuur en teamdynamiek, opgedaan in bijvoorbeeld topsport, defensie of een andere relevante context. 
* 
Je begrijpt hoe leiderschap, gedrag en cultuur bijdragen aan het succesvol realiseren van organisatieverandering. 
* 
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel gesproken als geschreven. 
* 
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het opstellen van hoogwaardige rapporten, papers en presentaties, met een scherp oog voor detail. 
* 
Je bent in staat complexe organisatievraagstukken te analyseren en te vertalen naar concrete en uitvoerbare oplossingen. 
* 
Uitstekende presentatie- en facilitatievaardigheden en ervaring in het voorbereiden en faciliteren van leiderschaps- en teamontwikkeling workshops 
* 
Affiniteit met AI en de toepassing ervan binnen people‑processen. 
* 
Teamplayer met het vermogen om zich snel en effectief in nieuwe teams te integreren. 
* 
Ervaren in het beheren van stakeholders en klantrelaties in een dynamische en complexe omgeving. 
* 
In staat om veerkracht te tonen in stressvolle omstandigheden en goed te presteren onder druk. 
* 
Het vermogen om projecten te beheersen, problemen te analyseren en bij te dragen aan inzichtelijke, praktische en duurzame oplossingen voor onze klanten. 
* 
Heeft sterke analytische vaardigheden en is in staat gedrag, cultuur en leiderschap in een organisatiecontext te analyseren en duiden. 
* 
Past effectieve verandermanagementprincipes toe om gedrags-, cultuur- en organisatieveranderingen tijdens transformaties te ondersteunen. 
Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier 
* 
Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Bovenop je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling). 
* 
Je krijgt een bepaald/onbepaald contract voor 40 uur. 
* 
Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding. 
* 
29 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken + de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen. 
* 
Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app. 
* 
Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt. 
* 
De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken. 
* 
De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen. 
* 
Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen. 
* 
Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing. 
* 
Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk. 
En dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik hier 
Jouw toekomst samen met ons vormgeven? | Over je sollicitatieproces 
Voor deze vacature vragen we je om naast je cv ook een motivatiebrief te uploaden. Hiermee krijg je de kans om jouw drijfveren, motivatie en persoonlijkheid aan ons te laten zien. Bij EY staan wij achter het gebruik van AI-tools zoals ChatGPT, zolang jouw eigen toon en unieke persoonlijkheid zichtbaar blijven. 
Ons eerste contact: na jouw sollicitatie belt onze recruiter jou binnen 5 dagen voor een korte kennismaking. We verkennen alvast kort over en weer of de functie bij jou zou passen. 
Het eerste gesprek: we vragen je om van tevoren een online assessment te maken. Geen standaard vragenlijst, maar game-based waarin zowel naar jouw cognitieve vaardigheden als je gedragsvoorkeuren wordt gekeken. In het gesprek bespreken we de uitkomsten met elkaar en is er ook een collega van de betreffende afdeling aanwezig. Tijdens deze wederzijdse kennismaking leren we jou graag kennen en heb jij gelegenheid om ook jouw vragen te stellen. 
Het tweede gesprek: Als wij na het eerste gesprek een match zien en jij ook nog enthousiast bent, volgt er een tweede kennismaking. In dit gesprek gaan we dieper in op de functie en andere relevante thema’s en soms maakt ook een businesscase onderdeel uit van de procedure. Het kan zijn dat er nog een laatste gesprek plaatsvindt. 
We zijn een match. Je ontvangt van ons een aanbod en we doen een pre-employment screening. Daarna start jouw nieuwe uitdaging. Welkom bij EY! 
Uit onderzoek blijkt dat vrouwen minder snel solliciteren wanneer ze niet aan álle criteria voldoen. Solliciteer gerust, ook als je niet aan alles voldoet.

jd_text:
Description de l'entreprise
Sia est un groupe international de conseil en management de nouvelle génération, fondé en 1999. Nés à l'ère du digital, nous sommes augmentés par la data, enrichis par la créativité et guidés par la responsabilité. Nous collaborons avec nos clients pour relever les défis et saisir les opportunités. Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nous croyons que l'optimisme est un puissant levier de transformation. Avec une expertise couvrant un large éventail de secteurs et de services, nos 3 000 consultants accompagnent des clients dans le monde entier, depuis 48 bureaux répartis dans 19 pays. Notre expertise produit des résultats concrets. Notre optimisme change la donne.

Description du poste
Pour accompagner le déploiement de l'IA agentique chez ses clients et en interne, Sia recrute un(e) consultant(e) Agent Builder.
L'Agent Builder conçoit, industrialise et fait adopter des agents IA : assistants métiers, automatisations multi-étapes, copilotes intégrés aux outils du client. Le poste est à la fois technique et fonctionnel : vous traduisez un besoin métier en agent qui fonctionne réellement en production, et vous en démontrez la valeur.
Au sein d'une équipe de consultants expérimentés et en plein essor, vous accompagnerez nos clients notamment sur les missions suivantes :
- Échanger avec les différentes parties prenantes pour identifier, qualifier et prioriser les cas d'usage agentiques à fort impact
- Concevoir l'architecture d'un agent : découpage des tâches, choix du modèle, outils et connecteurs, mémoire, garde-fous et points de contrôle humain
- Construire et itérer sur des agents avec les plateformes du marché (Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, LangGraph, n8n, Google AgentSpace, …etc.)
- Réaliser le prompt engineering et le context engineering : instructions système, découpage des skills, intégration des sources de connaissance (RAG, SharePoint, bases documentaires)
- Intégrer les agents au SI du client via API, MCP et connecteurs métiers (Microsoft 365, CRM, ERP, ITSM)
- Évaluer et fiabiliser : jeux de tests, mesure de la qualité des réponses, détection des régressions, suivi des coûts et de la latence
- Sécuriser le déploiement : gestion des droits et des données, traçabilité, conformité au cadre réglementaire applicable et aux politiques IA du client
- Accompagner l'adoption : formation des utilisateurs, documentation, transfert de compétences aux équipes du client
Dans le cadre des activités internes du cabinet, votre participation s'articule autour des axes suivants :
- Contribuer à la construction de nos offres et de nos accélérateurs sur l'IA agentique
- Capitaliser sur les agents, skills et briques réutilisables développés en mission
- Participer aux réponses aux appels d'offres et aux démonstrations client
- Animer la communauté interne : veille technologique, partages de bonnes pratiques, montée en compétence des équipes

Qualifications
Diplômé(e) d’un niveau Bac+5, vous disposez d'une expérience impérative sur des outils agentiques. Les candidatures sans pratique effective d'une plateforme de création d'agents ne pourront pas être retenues.
- Vous avez déjà conçu et mis en production au moins un agent IA avec un outil du marché : Microsoft Copilot Studio, Claude / Claude Agent SDK, Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI Assistants ou AgentKit, Google Agentspace, LangChain / LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n ou équivalent
- De 2 à 6 ans d'expérience en conseil, data, développement logiciel ou transformation digitale
- Diplôme d'une grande école d'ingénieurs, de commerce ou d'université, avec une composante technique ou data
- Maîtrise du prompt engineering et compréhension concrète des limites des LLM : hallucinations, fenêtre de contexte, coût, latence
- Maîtrise de Python et pratique des API REST ; la connaissance du protocole MCP est un plus significatif
- Compréhension des architectures RAG : découpage, embeddings, bases vectorielles, stratégies de récupération
- Expérience de l'écosystème Microsoft 365 et Power Platform, ou d'une plateforme cloud (Azure, GCP, AWS)

Informations supplémentaires
Pour plus d'information sur notre practice Data Science, consultez notre showroom de solutions IA : https://www.heka.ai/fr 
Rejoindre Sia, c’est : 
- Travailler sur des missions à fort impact dans des secteurs d’activités variés (énergie, luxe, transport, finance…), 
- Développer ses compétences grâce à un large choix de formations et certifications en data 
- Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, entre projets R&D à forte valeur ajoutée et partages d'expertise via des publications : https://sia-ai.medium.com/ 
- S’impliquer dans des initiatives transverses sur des thématiques actuelles comme l’IA générative ou la transition écologique 
Sia est un employeur qui souscrit au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi. Tous les aspects de l’emploi, tels que le recrutement, les promotions, la rémunération, ou les sanctions sont basés uniquement sur les performances, les compétences, et le comportement des employés ou les besoins de l’entreprise.

- Adoption de l’IA et embarquement d’une communauté de « AI Champions » en valorisant les bénéfices concrets dans les activités quotidiennes d’un acteur bancaire.

jd_text:
Job Description
PERL Associate- Consumer
As an Associate at Kearney, you'll help drive the next chapter of our Product Excellence and Renewal Lab (PERLab) — the team helping some of the world's most recognizable consumer brands rethink and reinvigorate their product portfolios for growth.
PERLab sits at a rare intersection: world-class product design fused with Kearney's operational rigor. In partnership with TEAMS Design — renowned for its work in product design, UX, and industrial design — we don't just advise from the outside. We tear products apart, walk the manufacturing line, and rebuild the supply chain from the inside, unlocking margin and efficiency at every stage of the product life cycle.
Our work spans the full arc of a product life — from shaping the category strategy behind a new launch and engineering products that win at scale, to finding the margin hiding in a portfolio and reinventing brands that have lost their edge.
As an Associate, you'll be in the middle of it all — leading workstreams, shaping recommendations that clients act on, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with designers, engineers, and category experts to solve problems that change what actually ends up on shelves. 
What you will do
Are you ready to:
- Work alongside a dedicated and diverse group of people to offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients?
- Leverage your consumer goods, commercial, or technical background to solve complex consulting challenges?
- Work at the intersection of consumer insight, consulting, and design?
- Use your knowledge of products, categories, and consumers to create real business impact?
- Let your curiosity about what consumers choose—and why—and your passion for solving tough problems sparks new solutions?
- Learn and grow by taking advantage of every opportunity available to you?
- Join a company that prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture?
- Be the difference and make it happen?
Who You Are
After 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies, and above all, people. That’s why we look for collaborative, insightful, and inquisitive problem-solvers who don’t accept the first thing in front of them and who are always unapologetically themselves.
- A highly analytical problem solver
- Curious about what consumers choose, why they choose it, and how products, brands, and categories win in the market
- Ready to take ownership of identifying and developing new capabilities that help our clients design stronger product portfolios, accelerate innovation, and drive profitable growth
- Bring 5–10 years of relevant professional experience
- Have experience in one or more of the following areas: consumer goods, consumer insights, category management, brand or product management, innovation, product development, packaging, R&D, commercial strategy, or supply chain
- Hold an MBA or other advanced degree; backgrounds in business, economics, engineering, design, retail, innovation management, supply chain, or related fields are preferred
- Are located near, or willing to relocate to, Chicago
- Are fluent in English 
What we can offer you
Every day, our people work to be the difference for our clients, our communities, and our colleagues. Helping them to make an impact, they are sustained by a competitive remuneration package plus comprehensive benefits and perks, including but not limited to:
- Generous retirement/pension saving contributions
- Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and their families
- Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities
- Personalized opportunities to help you chart a unique journey to pursue your own personal and professional goals
Compensation and benefits
PERL Associate – Electronics compensation range: $192k-194k
It is important to note that at Kearney, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role. Individual salaries within each range are determined through a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, and skills. Kearney reviews compensation regularly and may adjust base salaries to reflect market competitiveness. In addition to salary, individuals may be eligible for a discretionary performance bonus. Our full suite of benefits includes paid time off, paid sick leave, 401(k) match and profit sharing, medical, dental, and vision coverage, healthcare concierge services, backup child/adult care, annual employer HSA contributions, a home office stipend, subsidized gym membership, an annual wellness program, and leaves of absence when needed to support employees’ physical, mental, and emotional well-being.
Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination
Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients. That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws. This includes providing reasonable accommodation for disabilities or religious beliefs and practices. We encourage everyone to apply, including those who may not feel historically represented in consulting.

jd_text:
Job Description
Company Description
L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action. 
How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. 
Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognized as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com. 
About the Life Sciences Practice 
L.E.K.'s Life Sciences practice helps biotech and pharmaceutical companies, along with their investors and partners, build strategies that create lasting value from R&D through commercialization. Our teams combine scientific depth with rigorous, data-driven analysis to advise on corporate and franchise strategy, pipeline and asset evaluation, launch excellence, pricing and market access, and transactions across every stage of the deal lifecycle. 
JOB DESCRIPTION
If you are a bright, motivated leader interested in tackling some of the toughest and most interesting business problems in life sciences, consider joining L.E.K. as a Life Sciences Senior Consultant. 
Senior Consultants are central to our industry-leading life sciences work and sit at the core of our case team structure. Click here for more on our international Swap program.

jd_text:
Description de l'entreprise
Rejoignez un cabinet de conseil international qui accompagne les grandes transformations stratégiques.
Nous sommes Wavestone : des expert·es passionné·es et orienté·es solutions, qui placent l’humain au cœur de la performance et de la croissance. Ambitieux·ses et en pleine expansion, nous développons sans cesse notre portefeuille de clients et de projets, avec une portée internationale et une réelle volonté de générer un impact positif.
Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain.

Description du poste
Dans un contexte de crises sanitaires et économiques, marqué par une prise de conscience de l’urgence environnementale, le secteur de la banque et de l’assurance est plus que jamais garant du bon fonctionnement de notre société et de l’économie. En parallèle, la compétition entre les acteurs continue de s’intensifier, via la pression de nouveaux entrants en provenance de la tech et le basculement vers le digital s’est brusquement accéléré avec la pandémie de Covid-19.
Pour répondre à ces profondes mutations, les entreprises de la banque et de l’assurance font désormais face à plusieurs défis sur lesquels notre practice Financial Services les accompagne :
- Se réinventer en transformant leurs offres et leur business model, afin de conquérir de nouvelles parts de marché tout en contribuant à la transition écologique ;
- Innover pour réussir leur transformation digitale et technologique ;
- Améliorer leur performance opérationnelle afin de conserver leur rentabilité financière.
Rejoindre la practice Financial Services, c’est rejoindre 400 consultants qui accompagnent au quotidien leurs clients de la banque et de l’assurance, en tant que partenaire privilégié, dans la réussite de leurs grands projets de transformation.
En nous rejoignant, vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la déclinaison opérationnelle et la mise en œuvre technologique de leur stratégie métier, à travers : 
- La conception et le déploiement de nouveaux business models : accompagnement des démarches d’open-banking et d’open-insurance, cadrage et mise en œuvre de plateformes digitales et marketplaces (#Business-Case #Architecture-SI, #Aide au choix de solutions du marché, #Stratégie d’intégration IT) ;
- L’opérationnalisation de projets de partenariats : construction de la cible métier, IT et organisationnelle, précision du business case, pilotage du programme (#Radar fintechs / assurtechs, #Organisation cible, #Stratégie de rapprochement IT) ;
- La digitalisation des parcours et process métiers : optimisation de l’expérience client, personnalisation des parcours utilisateurs, transformation des process collaborateurs (#Design de parcours, #Digitalisation, #Data, #IA, #Machine Learning)
- Le développement d’offres durables : conception de nouvelles offres ESG, étude d’impact sur le système d’informations, accompagnement au respect des réglementations et adaptation des politiques RSE (#Développement d’offres, #Benchmark marché, #Etude d’impact IT) ;
- L’amélioration des modèles opérationnels IT : optimisation de la performance des modèles opérationnels IT, du déploiement de nouveaux modes de fonctionnement lean-agile à la transformation des modèles de sourcing (#Performance, #NextGenSourcing #NextGenOrga #Budget #Agilité à l’échelle).
Pour aller plus loin dans la compréhension de nos savoir-faire et la valeur qu’ils apportent à nos clients au quotidien, vous pouvez consulter nos plus beaux succès clients.
Enfin, en rejoignant la practice Financial Services, nous aurez la possibilité de participer activement à la vie interne du cabinet à travers : 
- Le développement de nos offres, la réalisation d’activités de veille afin d’enrichir nos radars Fintechs / Assurtechs et la rédaction d’articles ;
- Le développement de nos Assets : Shake 'up, The Factory, CréaDesk, Machine Learning & Data Lab, Research & Knowledge Center ;
- La contribution au recrutement, aux relations écoles, à la réponse à des propositions commerciales, aux formations internes ;
- La participation à la stratégie RSE de Wavestone.

Qualifications
Motivé·e pour apprendre et diplômé·e d'une grande école d'ingénieurs, de management ou d'une grande université, vous êtes attiré·e par le conseil et vous possédez une forte l’appétence par la transformation des banques-assurances et digitale. 
Vous souhaitez développer des compétences liées au métier du conseil et aux problématiques de transformation des organisations.
Vos atouts : 
- Curiosité, esprit d’analyse aiguisé et capacité à vous approprier de nouveaux sujets
- Orientation client, excellent relationnel et sens du service
- Goût du challenge et des résultats 
- Attrait pour l'entreprenariat et l'innovation
Par ailleurs, vous voulez être acteur·rice d'un projet d'entreprise ambitieux en pleine croissance en France et à l'international. Vous avez envie de mettre votre enthousiasme au service d'un cabinet qui saura vous proposer une prise de responsabilités rapide. 
Une expérience dans le domaine n'est pas requise pour ce poste, le plus important est votre appétence pour les enjeux liés à la transformation sectorielle et digitale.

Informations supplémentaires
Wavestone est un employeur inclusif qui s'engage pour l'égalité des chances. Dans le cadre de cette politique de diversité et inclusion, Wavestone accompagne les personnes en situation de handicap et/ou nécessitant un aménagement durant leur process de recrutement et lors de leur prise de poste. Le dispositif de télétravail est largement déployé au sein de Wavestone pour tous les métiers.

Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Job Description
Your Role 
As a Data Analytics Consultant, you will be at the heart of delivering impactful data-driven strategies to our clients. You will collaborate closely with local and international clients to bridge the gap between business objectives and technical execution. 
You will help deliver actionable data-driven solutions & insights, and present the results in an interactive, easily understandable manner. 
What you will do 
- Collaborate with stakeholders to define business goals and shape solution blueprints through workshops and mock-ups. 
- Prepare and validate data by mapping, extracting, cleaning, enriching, and performing feature engineering to establish stable datasets for analysis. 
- Design, implement, and automate interactive dashboards and customized reports that cater to specific client requirements using advanced visualization tools. 
- Conduct comprehensive statistical analysis and exploratory data investigations to extract actionable insights supporting decision-making. 
- Translate complex technical and analytical findings into clear, understandable presentations for non-technical stakeholders. 
- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data analytics, applying innovative approaches to enhance service offerings. 
- Provide guidance and support to business users and team members in leveraging data effectively, contributing to a data-driven culture and continuous learning. 
Within Sia, you will 
- Contribute to enhancing Sia’s Data Science and Generative AI offerings through internal training sessions, working groups, and publications. 
- Represent Sia at professional events, actively contributing to thought leadership (articles, white papers, webinars). 
- Support business development by crafting proposals/offers, identifying collaboration opportunities, and nurturing long-term client relationships.

Qualifications
About You 
You bring: 
- A Master's degree in Business, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
- 0–3 years of experience in data analytics or a relevant consulting or industry role. 
- Fluency in Dutch or French, and English. 
- Strategic thinking with strong analytical skills and a proactive approach. 
- Experience in clearly communicating and presenting complex ideas to varied audiences. 
- Efficient collaboration with various stakeholders, internally and externally, to gather requirements and support data-driven decisions. 
- Eagerness to work alongside and learn from more experienced colleagues while contributing fresh ideas to team projects. 
- You have a strong interest in data and AI-related topics, the ability to quickly build expertise in these areas, and you’re excited about helping our clients seize the opportunities they offer.
- Interest in applying innovative analytics and AI solutions to drive sustainability and create meaningful business impact. 
Your technical toolkit: 
- Hands-on experience with Python or R for data analysis. 
- Proficiency with SQL and Microsoft Excel for data manipulation. 
- Familiarity with dashboarding tools like Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. 
- Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a strong plus. 
Why Join Us? 
- Tailored career development with ongoing training in analytics, AI, and consulting skills. 
- Project diversity: Collaborate on high-impact assignments across sectors and geographies. 
- Flexibility: Hybrid work model combining office, remote, and client-based work. 
- Attractive compensation package including annual raises, bonuses, and personalized mobility options. 
- Global network: Be part of a vibrant international consulting community with thought leaders in AI and analytics.

Additional Information
Unfortunately, we are unable to provide a work permit for this position. 
Sia is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or disciplinary actions, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, and business needs.

jd_text:
Job Description
 Maximize your potential. Tackle the world’s toughest problems.
Build expertise in areas that matter to you. Become a global development leader.
ABOUT DALBERG
We are a global group working to build a more sustainable planet and inclusive societies where all people can thrive. As a diverse, purpose-driven community of professionals, it works in collaboration with local communities and global networks to create bold and equitable solutions and develop the next generation of impact leaders. Dalberg brings together strategy and management consulting, equity-centered community design, data, research, implementation, and communications to achieve its mission of solving the most pressing challenges of our time through systemic change. We are from everywhere, at home anywhere - an African and American company as much as an Asian, Latin American, Middle Eastern, and European one. 
Dalberg is a place where a diverse mix of talented individuals are able to practice transparency and openness while maintaining independence of thought – whether it’s how you identify, where you come from, the languages you speak, the person you love, or the way you worship. Dalberg is a home where people feel safe, understood, nurtured, and encouraged to grow. 
As a team of 610+ people from 55 countries, speaking over 90 languages collectively, with 48%+ female leadership team, Dalberg places diversity, equity and inclusion principles at the heart of our organization and the work we do alongside our clients, partners and communities. 
Established in 2001 by experienced private sector consultants, Dalberg operates from 25+ worldwide locations. For more information, please visit Dalberg.
ABOUT DALBERG ADVISORS
Dalberg Advisors is a strategic advisory firm combining the best of private sector strategy skills and rigorous analytical capabilities with deep knowledge and networks across emerging and frontier markets. We work collaboratively across the public, private and philanthropic sectors to fuel inclusive growth and help clients achieve their goals.
ABOUT OUR CLIENTS
Our clients come to us with some of the most difficult global problems, seeking solutions where the obvious ones have failed. We are entrepreneurs and innovators, designers and creative problem solvers, thinkers, and doers who supply new ideas, drawing from a deep base of knowledge that cuts across sectors and geographies and is growing every day. We partner with and serve communities, governments, and companies throughout the world. Some of our recent clients include foundations such as the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, corporations such as Pepsi and Vodafone, multilateral institutions such as the World Bank and the Inter-American Development Bank, UN agencies such as UNICEF and the UNEP, and government agencies such as the Ethiopian Ministry of Innovation and Technology, USAID, and India’s NITI Aayog.
ABOUT YOU
You aspire to become a leader in global development by tackling global issues, from malnutrition to climate change to economic growth, ensuring no population is left behind. You drive the delivery of innovative and results-oriented solutions for clients, proposing problem-solving and creating tailored frameworks that address client challenges. You excel in solving problems using clear strategic and creative thinking, and you want to put your skills to work – transforming organizations that fund change around the world. You are a committed self-starter with experience as a ‘top-performer’ at a leading international management consultancy firm, a passion for international development, and an entrepreneurial spirit. 
Dalberg consultants live and work around the world, creating a network of local experience anchored by our offices in Africa, Latin America, North America, Europe and Asia. Dalberg combines ground-level insight with experience from top-tier professional services firms and leading academic institutions to create actionable solutions to the world’s most pressing issues. 
Typical qualifications for a Consultant 
- Minimum of bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, International Relations or a related field 
- Excellent academic record 
- Minimum 2 years’ experience as a ‘top performer’ at a leading international management consultancy, or a similar type of private sector experience 
- Strong analytical abilities, both quantitative and qualitative 
- Ability to present information in an insightful and structured manner, both written and oral 
- Experience living and working in different cultures; time spent in developing countries strongly preferred 
- Professionalism and demonstrated experience working directly with clients, including senior management of corporate and/or top officials in the public sector 
- Sensitivity to the political and cultural environments of international public agencies or similarly complex environments 
- Demonstrated fluency with English speaking and writing skills; proficiency with other languages a plus 
Note: Employment in all the Dalberg offices is conditional on the candidate having or obtaining the requisite authorization to live and work in that country. 
WHAT WILL YOU DO AND HOW WILL YOU GROW
Consultants play a significant role in driving the delivery of innovative and results-oriented solutions for our clients. They lead research and analysis for the case, framing the team’s knowledge base around the topic at hand. This includes both, quantitative rigor and gaining primary insights through interviews with stakeholders. As those who dive deep into the issues, they think critically and creatively to develop insights based on their findings from the research process. They gain a broad knowledge base that cuts across sectors and geographies while driving the core of every project’s work. Not only do Consultants work closely with their managers, but they are also tasked with gaining trust and credibility by working directly with clients and change makers. 
Examples of recent projects that Dalberg consultants have worked on include designing policy and regulatory roadmaps for inclusive credit across Africa and Asia, developing multi-year strategies for environmental and philanthropic organizations, and launching initiatives to strengthen development impact in Europe. We’ve assessed technical capacity needs to support global agriculture, explored blended finance opportunities in the off-grid solar sector, and mapped AI-for-good use cases in low- and middle-income countries. Our work also includes evaluating labour rights in agri-food supply chains, supporting livelihood strategies in the private sector, and guiding business planning in the energy access space. We've facilitated disability inclusion roundtables and led the transition of public engagement programs.
Past projects have taken us to a mine in the Indonesian jungle, to refugee camps in remote parts of Kenya, and to the Nepal border to study trafficking transport chains.
Dalberg is a platform for change. Our staff is empowered to start new programs, institute best practices, and develop traditions that will define the Dalberg experience for years to come. Innovation and entrepreneurship are not only valued at Dalberg; they are essential to our firm’s success. In addition to providing training, management-level advising, and mentoring, we empower consultants to learn by doing, engaging them as core members of project teams from day one. 
JOIN OUR TEAM
Our current opportunities are in London and Geneva
Please submit your application at our Career Centre by Sunday 1st November 21:00 GMT / 22:00 CET
Your application should include a resume, and short cover letter. 
Interviews will test consulting skills through case questions and discuss the candidate’s interests and experience. A candidate’s specific title and level of entry will be assessed during the interview process.
During the same recruitment period, please only apply to one position at Dalberg. This position should be the role best suited to your current professional experience and to your first preference location. 
Candidate applications will be considered on a rolling basis. Candidates selected for interviews will be invited for a number of interviews to test analytical and conceptual thinking skills through consulting case questions, and to discuss interests and experience. A candidate’s specific title and level of entry will be assessed during the interview process.
Dalberg values its people and recognizes the importance of balancing professional and personal demands. Qualified and interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, race, religion, background, or ethnic affiliation are encouraged to apply for the vacancy. 
- COMMITMENT 1: We commit to publishing internal Dalberg DEI reports annually, to hold ourselves accountable, report on progress and share lessons from our regional DEI plans. 
- COMMITMENT 2: We commit to delivering regular training for all staff (including leadership) on how to engender inclusive workplaces and mitigate unconscious bias.
- COMMITMENT 3: We commit to addressing imbalances in how power and privilege are formally distributed and informally exercised across the firm.
Owing to the large number of applications we receive, unfortunately, only successful candidates will be contacted.
Please Note: 
- Employment in our Geneva office is contingent on the candidate having the requisite authorizations to live and work in Switzerland respectively. 
- Candidates shortlisted for interviews will be invited for 3 to 4 rounds to test problem-solving and conceptual thinking skills through consulting case questions, and to discuss interests and experience this will include online and face to face interviews.

jd_text:
Job Description
L.E.K. Consulting is a premier global strategy consulting firm that partners with clients to solve their most critical business challenges and deliver high-impact outcomes. We bring deep industry expertise and rigorous, evidence-based insight to global corporations, growth companies and private equity investors, helping them turn strategy into action.
 How do we deliver impact? It’s the people. We hire exceptional individuals and invest in their growth through hands-on client work, close collaboration and a culture of ownership, inclusion and continuous learning. Across every level, curiosity unites us and challenge excites us. Founded more than 40 years ago, L.E.K. employs more than 2,200 professionals worldwide and is consistently recognised as one of the industry's best firms to work for. For more information, visit lek.com.
The Team
This role sits within L.E.K.’s Industrials team, one of our fastest-growing practices across Europe. The team works with leading corporates and investors on the major trends reshaping industry, from the energy transition, electrification and sustainable infrastructure to AI, automation, digitalisation and evolving global supply chains. Our work spans Building & Construction, Industrial Equipment & Technology, and Energy & Environment, offering exposure to a broad range of businesses, markets and strategic challenges.
As the practice continues to grow across Europe, we are expanding both our client base and our capabilities across strategy, M&A, operations and supply chain, pricing, and digital, data & analytics. Team members work collaboratively across offices and have the opportunity to build deep sector expertise while contributing to the continued growth and development of the Industrials practice.
The Role
Consultants play a central role within L.E.K. case teams, shaping the approach to client problems and translating analysis into clear, practical recommendations. They act as an important link between senior team members, junior colleagues and clients, helping to ensure that project work is delivered to a consistently high standard.
Working closely with Managers, Principals and Partners, Consultants lead workstreams, identify key client issues, structuring and managing analysis and contributing to the development of practical, evidence-based recommendations, while managing the day-to-day work of Associates.
Location: London
Key responsibilities
- Define the client’s key business issues, priorities and the critical questions to answer
- Structure and lead workstreams across market, customer, competitor, financial and strategic analysis

 Who are we
 As a global consulting partnership in more than 40 countries, our people make us who we are. We’re individuals with different passions and strengths who take as much joy in the work we do as from those we work with. Over the years we’ve fostered a culture in which we are united by shared values—passion, solidarity, generosity, curiosity and boldness—and these come alive in the work we do and how we do it. 
 Together, we know our people are our difference—for our clients, our colleagues, and our communities. That’s why we take pride in being individual and inclusive and create a place where everyone can bring their full self to work. 
 Make your mark as a Senior Business Analyst at Kearney
 Are you ready to:

- Join a company which prides itself on its shared values and inclusive culture?

Being rooted in expertise, we know our people deserve opportunities to go places and further their exposure to the business world. 
 Grow. We believe in the power of apprenticeship. At Kearney, you work alongside colleagues who help you be the best you can be. Through both, our structured programs and apprenticeship model, you will continue to learn and develop every day. After all, we are here to help you not just perform, but to thrive in your career. 
 Be yourself. At Kearney, we give you the freedom to contribute creatively while you also pursue your dreams. We want you to bring your whole self to work and to find joy in what you do. That’s why we support our people when they want to let their uniqueness show and offer personalized opportunities including tuition support, flexible work programs, and externships.
 Who you are
 If you’re reading this, you’re smart enough to already know what we’re looking for. Insightful, yes. Inquisitive, naturally. Collaborative, of course. Job Description
As a Senior Business Analyst, you will be a key contributor to the growth and development of our Strategic Operations (SOP) practice-Source Tower as we offer honest advice and practical guidance to our clients. 
Working alongside a dedicated and diverse set of people, you will work alongside our clients to define and implement strategies that will deliver both short-term results and longer-term competitiveness in this ever-changing market environment. 
Through unique hands-on experiences, you will broaden your knowledge across a breadth of topics while developing relationships with clients and colleagues across the firm. With the freedom to be yourself and recognition for what you bring to the table, you can put your purpose into action and help build a future that works for everyone, everywhere—as a Kearney Original. 
Who you are 
After nearly 100 years, we know this business is fundamentally about making connections—between facts, figures, insights, strategies, tools, technologies, and above all, people. That’s why we look for collaborative, insightful, and inquisitive problem-solvers who don’t accept the first thing in front of them and who are always unapologetically themselves. 
We Want to Hear From You If You Are
- Insightful, inquisitive, and collaborative.
- Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Have functional experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Strategic sourcing and category management
- Procurement operating model design
- Cost optimization and value capture
- Supplier collaboration and risk management
- Apply strong expertise in one or more core sourcing capabilities, with a broad understanding of the broader procurement landscape, including:
- Category management
- Strategic sourcing
- Procurement and digital purchasing transformation
- Supplier relationship management (SRM)
- Vendor negotiation and contracting strategies
- Apply procurement expertise across industries to improve efficiency, resilience, and innovation.
- Contribute to thought leadership, tools, and methodologies that strengthen Kearney’s sourcing and procurement capabilities.
In Addition, We Look for Individuals with the Following Experience or Qualities
- 3–5 years of professional experience.
- A master's degree, or an undergraduate degree with relevant work experience.
- Experience working as a Management Consultant preferred.
- Located near, or willing to relocate to, Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dallas, Detroit, New York, San Francisco, or Washington, D.C.
- This role requires approximately 50–80% travel, based on client and business needs.
What we can offer you:
Every day, our people make a difference for our clients, communities, and colleagues. We support them with a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits, including:
· Generous retirement/pension savings contributions
· Comprehensive medical insurance for employees and immediate family
· Gym membership discounts
· Non-partner equity-based awards (for consulting managers and above)
· Structured and on-the-job learning and development opportunities
· Personalized career pathways, including mobility programs, flexible work arrangements, and externships
Senior Business Analyst base salary - $123,000 - $127,000: However, it is important to note that at Kearney, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role. Individual salaries within each range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, office location, knowledge and skills. Kearney reviews compensation regularly and may adjust base salaries to reflect market competitiveness. In addition to salary, individuals may be eligible for a discretionary performance bonus. Our full suite of benefits includes paid time off, paid sick time off, 401(k) match and profit sharing, medical, dental and vision coverage, healthcare concierge, backup child/adult care, annual employer HSA contribution, home office stipend, subsidized Gympass and annual wellness program, and leaves of absence when needed to support employees’ physical, mental, and emotional well-being. 
Read more about our benefits and a career at Kearney.com/careers. 
Equal employment opportunity and non-discrimination 
Kearney prides itself on providing a culture where our employees belong and thrive equally, which means our people feel comfort, confidence, and joy as they do great things for our firm, our colleagues, and our clients. That’s why Kearney is committed to building a diverse workforce and inclusive environment. Kearney is an equal opportunity employer; we recruit, hire, train, promote, develop, and provide other conditions of employment without regard to a person’s gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, religion, age, national origin, disability, marital status, pregnancy status, veteran status, genetic information, or any other differences consistent with applicable laws. You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients. You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking. THE WORK Utilize relevant AI tools across all tasks and deliverable creation, including the creation of agents and other tools to help facilitate: Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states. Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context. Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools. Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives. Client Engagement & Advisory Support Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions. Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders. Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams. Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples. Data & AI Foundations Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems. Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations. Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows. Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.
BASIC (REQUIRED) QUALIFICATIONS 1.5- 4years of experience (co-ops, or coursework) in supply chain management, operations, business analysis, or a related field. Demonstrated functional understanding of at least one supply chain domain: Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, or Fulfillment / Logistics. Familiarity with core AI concepts — including Agentic AI fundamentals, AI use case identification, and AI reference architecture at a conceptual level. Experience writing or contributing to structured business documents such as process maps, requirements documents, or functional specifications — in an academic or professional setting. Demonstrated ability to work with and synthesize data into clear, structured insights or recommendations. Experience using AI tools (e.g., GenAI platforms, AI-assisted research or productivity tools) in an academic or professional context. Strong written and verbal communication skills with an ability to explain complex concepts clearly to non-technical audiences. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS MBA or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related discipline. Coursework, certifications, or self-directed learning in AI, machine learning, or data platforms (e.g., cloud certifications, AI/ML specializations). Exposure to consulting environments through internships, case competitions, or strategy project work — with demonstrated ability to structure problems and communicate recommendations. Familiarity with enterprise planning or ERP platforms (e.g., SAP IBP, o9, Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Oracle SCM) in an academic or professional context. Participation in supply chain case competitions, AI hackathons, or strategy projects with measurable outcomes. Working knowledge of data visualization or analytics tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) applied in a supply chain or operations context. Understanding of Prompt Engineering or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques — even at a foundational or experimental level.

Description 
 About Alvarez & Marsal 
 Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
 The Team 
 The A&M Global Transaction Advisory Group (“GTAG”) is comprised of former Big Four CPAs and CAs who provide private equity and corporate clients buy side and sell side financial accounting due diligence. GTAG professionals actively engage in assessing a target’s quality of earnings, analyzing cash flows, reviewing working capital, identifying key business drivers, reviewing forecasts, and conducting comprehensive discussions with management and their advisors. GTAG professionals routinely team with the firm’s operational, tax, commercial, and information technology professionals to deliver a truly integrated solution to clients.
 How you will contribute 
- Assist with core financial due diligence, helping to identify key risks and potential deal breakers, assess the strengths and weaknesses of the business against industry benchmarks, and assist with the evaluation of the potential transaction in the context of their clients’ investment strategy.
- Analyse detailed financial statement information including income statement, balance sheet, cash flow and key operational data. Synthesize and convert the data into meaningful information that is used to drive discussions with target management and drive observations and conclusions.
- Assess the quality of the target company's reported earnings, net assets and cash flows.
- After an investigative analysis, assist in the construction of deal-oriented reports and presentations for clients that highlight the key financial, commercial and other findings facing investments and the drivers behind maintainable profits and cash flows. Assist the team in further articulating how such findings should be incorporated into the client's valuation and sale / purchase agreement and provide other negotiating points.
- Participate in meetings and conference calls with target company management and with client personnel and will serve as an additional point of contact for client personnel with respect to day-to-day execution matters.
- Displays the ability to manage and prioritize assigned responsibilities and proactively consults with superiors.
- Ability to assist with multiple chargeable and non-chargeable projects of varying size and complexity.
- Possesses the ability to self-review and critique project databooks.
- Possesses appropriate report writing skills in order to assist the engagement team in writing full DD report.
- Ability to assist the engagement team in Quality of Earnings, P&L and Working Capital analysis with guidance from the engagement manager.
- Able to assist the engagement manager with engagement issues (e.g., billing, status updates, scope changes) including preparation of scope of procedures, request lists, etc.
- Can effectively assist engagement managers with day-to-day client interaction on deals.
- Works with engagement manager to develop and propose creative solutions to engagement and transaction risks.
- Consistently displays desire to take on more responsibility.
- Gathers applicable conflict check information and coordinates with Managing Directors to set up engagement codes and other engagement requirements.
 Qualifications 
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in accounting and/or related major
- CPA or CA certification preferred
- Big Four experience required
- Fluent in English, and either one of the following languages is preferred: Mandarin Chinese, Bahasa Melayu, Bahasa Indonesia, Tagalog or Vietnamese.
- Ability to travel within the region (where practical and possible)
- Solid hands-on experience working in Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, or Vietnam (in country), preferably with one of the Big Four accounting firms.
- Strong excel and power point skills required. Experience with data analytics and visualization software (i.e., Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) strongly preferred.
- The ideal candidate for the Senior Associate position will have at least 2 years of audit experience at a Big Four accounting firm as well as a preferred minimum of 2 years of experience in a financial accounting due diligence group.
- The ideal candidate for the Associate position will have at least 2 years of audit experience at a Big Four accounting firm.
- The successful candidate will be ranked a Top Performer in his or her peer group and furthermore, driven to success, a self-starter, and have strong interpersonal and communication skills. The individual will be insightful, decisive, a critical thinker, and commercial. Further, the individual will be able to work well on teams however will develop the knowledge and maturity to work with our clients independently.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills including the ability to articulate to senior members of target management, client representatives and colleagues
- Highly analytical mind-set
- Strong project management skills
- Deep accounting skills including a working knowledge of IFRS
- Team-oriented personality
- Professional in style and demeanor/exercises good judgment
- Motivated and effective in a fast-paced culture
 Your journey at A&M 
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
 We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

 Service Management Transformation: Lead the design and delivery of enhanced service management capabilities, processes, and operating models aligned to ITIL v4, DevOps, and Agile, driving innovation, agility, service quality, and cost optimisation.

- Cloud Transition Strategy: Define actionable roadmaps and transitional states to support migration from on-premise to hybrid and multi-cloud environments, enabling scalable and resilient service models. 
- Automation & AI Enablement: Champion an AI-first mindset by embedding automation into service management designs, tooling, and processes to deliver measurable business value and operational efficiencies. 
- Consulting Leadership & Growth: Contribute to practice development, lead sustainable transformations, and support business development.
