 Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
 Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
 Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.
 Your Profile 
 • Practical experience designing and implementing Service Management frameworks aligned to ITIL V4, optimising ITSM tooling, defining operating models, and driving IT and business automation.
• Comfortable in client-facing roles with expertise in business case generation, commercial processes and business development.
• Proven track record of successfully delivering and leading advisory engagements, managing teams, building trusted relationships internally and externally, and influencing skills to support sales generation.
• Practical experience managing and implementing cloud centres of excellence, ITIL frameworks, SIAM models, Operating Models, AI optimisation and understand hybrid/multi-cloud environments, DevOps, CI/CD, Lean and Agile Methodology.
 The following are advantageous:
• Currently working in a Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a service management background. Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
• Experience of proposition building and delivery. 
• Business development – utilising a combination of the organisation’s broader pre-existing relationships, company relationships and your own network.

jd_text:
Om Capgemini Invent
 Vi på Capgemini Invent tror på att olikheter driver förändring. Som transformationskonsulter förenar vi strategiska, kreativa och vetenskapliga kompetenser och samarbetar nära våra kunder för att leverera lösningar i framkant. Bli en del av oss och driv transformation anpassad efter våra kunders utmaningar. Med vetenskap och data som grund, kreativitet och design som drivkraft – och teknik skapad med syfte som möjliggörare. 
 Hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta i gränslandet mellan affär och teknik, tillsammans med några av branschens främsta experter. 
 Din roll
 Var med och forma framtidens samhällsviktiga kommunikationer och bidra till ett mer motståndskraftigt Sverige. 
 På Capgemini Invent driver vi några av Sveriges mest betydelsefulla transformationer inom telekomsektorn. Just nu arbetar vi med utvecklingen av verksamhetskritisk kommunikation (Mission Critical Communications, MCX) för offentliga verksamheter, där säkra och robusta kommunikationstjänster är avgörande för samhällets funktion. 
 Vi söker nu en Business Analyst som vill ta en aktiv roll i våra kunduppdrag från första dagen. Du kommer att vara en nyckelperson i att driva aktiviteter framåt, omvandla affärsbehov till tydliga krav och bidra till framgångsrik leverans i komplexa transformationsinitiativ inom telekom. 
 I rollen kommer du bland annat att: 
- Driva och följa upp aktiviteter inom strategiska transformationsprogram inom telekom 
- Samla in, strukturera och dokumentera verksamhetskrav samt stödja prioritering och beslutsfattande 
- Säkerställa kvalitet, konsekvens och leverans av kundanpassade projektmaterial och beslutsunderlag 
- Stödja planering, implementering och koordinering mellan olika verksamhets- och teknikområden 
- Använda AI och nya teknologier för att effektivisera arbetssätt, analyser och leveranser 
 Din profil 
 Vi söker dig som är analytisk, strukturerad och trivs i en konsultmiljö där du får ta ansvar och skapa värde tillsammans med kund och team. 
 Vi tror att du har:
- 1-3 års erfarenhet som Business Analyst, managementkonsult, PMO, projektkoordinator eller liknande roll, gärna inom telekom 
- Stark analytisk förmåga och erfarenhet av att omsätta affärsbehov till konkreta krav och lösningar 
- Förståelse för affärsdriven transformation stöttad av IT-leveranser, systemutvecklingsprocesser och AI driven processutveckling 
- Erfarenhet från telekomoperatörer såsom Telia, Tele2, Telenor eller liknande verksamheter 
- Civilingenjörsexamen inom Industriell Ekonomi eller motsvarande examen inom ekonomi och management 
- Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift 
- Svenskt medborgarskap, vilket är ett krav på grund av kundernas säkerhetskrav 
 Varför Capgemini Invent?
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att: 
- Arbeta i några av Sveriges mest samhällskritiska transformationsprojekt 
- Utvecklas i en ledande konsultverksamhet med starkt fokus på innovation och teknologi 
- Samarbeta med experter inom strategi, affärsutveckling, teknik och AI och bidra till lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för samhället 
- Bygga en karriär i en global organisation med entreprenöriell kultur och stora utvecklingsmöjligheter 
 Bra att veta
 Placering: För denna roll utgår du från vårt centralt belägna Stockholmskontor och är redo att resa till kund vid behov. 
 Senioritet och titel fastställs baserat på din bakgrund och erfarenhet. 
 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomförs identitetskontroll via ID ‑ handling, och bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma vid behov. 
 Är du redo att kombinera affärsförståelse, analys och teknik för att skapa framtidens telekomlösningar? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

jd_text:
Description 
 About Alvarez & Marsal 
 Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A&M.
 The Team 
 The Corporate Transactions Group advises clients across the deal lifecycle on complex transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, capital raising, and restructuring situations. The team delivers integrated financial advisory services, combining deep corporate finance expertise with rigorous financial analysis and valuation capabilities. As part of a collaborative, fast-paced environment, Associates gain hands-on exposure to a broad range of transactions across industries, working closely with senior professionals and clients to deliver high-impact outcomes.
 How you will contribute 
- Support transaction execution across buy-side and sell-side engagements, including M&A, joint ventures, and capital market transactions
- Perform detailed financial analysis, valuation modeling (DCF, comparable companies, precedent transactions), and scenario analysis
- Prepare transaction materials such as financial models, information memoranda, management presentations, and investor materials
- Assist with due diligence processes, including analysis of financial statements, forecasts, and key value drivers
- Conduct market, industry, and company-specific research to support strategic and financial recommendations
- Collaborate with internal teams and external advisors to ensure timely and high-quality deliverables
- Contribute to the development of insights and recommendations for clients under the guidance of Managers and Directors
 Qualifications 
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline
- 2–4 years of relevant experience in corporate finance, transaction advisory, investment banking, valuation, or financial consulting (Senior Associate level typically requires additional experience)
- Strong financial modeling and valuation skills with a solid understanding of corporate finance concepts
- High proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with financial databases is an advantage
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
- Ability to manage multiple workstreams in a deadline-driven environment
- Professional qualifications (e.g., CFA, CPA, CA, MBA) are an advantage but not required
 Your journey at A&M 
 We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
 We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

 About Alvarez & Marsal 
 Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals.  A&M Corporate Finance

Our Corporate Finance team has extensive experience of delivering deals for our clients including founders, entrepreneurs, financial investors of all sizes, and market-leading corporations across all industries globally.
 How you will contribute 
 We are looking for an Associate to join the team based in Dublin, driving its growth and penetration working with our Pan-European teams and working with the most demanding clients at the senior management level throughout the transaction lifecycle.
 You will have the opportunity to build on your existing capabilities, learn new skills and sectoral expertise and leverage on your interest in key sectors. You will assist in growing our practice and in winning and executing business with marquee clients across the corporate and private equity landscape. You will be an important member of a fast-growing team and will help shape our culture and values.

 Transaction origination and execution: 
- Playing a key role as part of the execution team for M&A mandates 
- Being a core part of the origination team working across the pitching effort 
- Operating as a keen multi-tasker in order to deliver on demanding timetables 
- Working in close coordination with other teams of A&M across the UK and internationally on both origination and execution Transaction management: 
- Along with the transaction team leader, take ownership of financial modelling and pricing with a focus of bringing real world insight to the analysis 
- In conjunction with other client advisors, assist with all transactional documentation with a focus on transaction marketing materials 
- Support the overall transaction process management (data room, other advisors, and coordination) 
- Provide support in the preparation of valuation analyses, including public comparable, precedent transactions, discounted cashflow analysis, LBO/IRR analysis, etc. 
- Monitor news and developments in relation to targeted industries and client groups Qualifications 
- Qualified accountant preferred but not essential

We Do Consulting Differently 
 BRG’s Financial Institution Advisory practice specializes in helping commercial banks, consumer finance companies, credit unions, mortgage banks, capital market participants and insurance companies solve pressing complex business issues. The group brings a mix of functional experts—including CPAs, CFAs, CROs, CRCMs, FRMs, former regulators, financial modelers, technologists, former bankers, and longtime consultants—to address immediate risks and drive tangible benefits.
 The team of experts are looking for a highly energetic, junior level CPA, with 2 to 6 years of experience, who is eager to take their public accounting audit experience to the next level. Rather than auditing, you will be doing a variety of more challenging work such as analyzing financial statements, helping clients implement new accounting standards, performing investigations into accounting policies / practices, and addressing whether audit procedures were executed sufficiently. Other assignments include helping clients implement new accounting and risk systems and assisting financial institutions in executing transactions including portfolio acquisitions, mergers and spin-offs. The work will be varied and high paced such that you will get a broad array of experience that you may not be exposed to at the Big 4 or other large accounting firms. 
 The ideal candidate is a licensed CPA (or has passed multiple exam sections) with hands-on experience executing SEC registrant audits at a large public accounting firm. We highly prefer candidates who bring a solid baseline knowledge of financial instruments and possess direct audit experience within the financial services sector, specifically with banks, fintechs, broker-dealers, REITs, investment management firms, or insurance companies.
 BRG is high-end boutique consulting firm that works for premier global institutions, regulators and also serves in an expert witness role in some of the most contentious accounting and auditing litigation. The Financial Institution Advisory group is small enough that you will immediately feel comfortable in the group but big enough to work on some of the most high-profile matters impacting the financial services world. 
 Responsibilities 
- Work directly with senior professionals (many of whom are former Big 4) to execute various financial institution advisory projects related to accounting, auditing, financial analysis. Unlike the Big 4 you will also have the opportunity to work on financial risk management engagements including credit risk, valuation, capital planning, and stress-testing, liquidity, resolution planning, and model risk management. Functional areas of work encompass accounting, auditing, SEC reporting, regulatory, risk and controls; finance and accounting; technology enablement; and business process optimization. 
- Work on data / document intensive projects, including analytics, controls, governance, and financial analysis, to support a variety of different engagements. 
- Plan and manage all aspects or certain aspects of client engagements depending on their size and complexity. 
- Delegate assignments to staff, instruct and monitor progress, and review work product for completeness and accuracy. 
- Develop analyses and client ready work product that demonstrates insights in to the key risks or roadblocks related to the matter. 
- Establish controls and procedures to ensure the accuracy of analyses and conclusions. 
- Manage client relationships and communicate results and work products as appropriate. 
- Demonstrate creativity and efficient use of relevant software tools, analytical methods and computer models to develop solutions. 
- Participate in group practice meetings, contribute to business development initiatives and office functions such as staff training and recruiting. 
- Prioritize assignments and responsibilities in order to meet goals and deadlines.
 Financial Industry / Product Knowledge 
 Some foundational knowledge related to the any of the below areas is preferred:
- Banking (community / regional / money center / international / international branch) 
- Mortgage (originators, servicers, secondary marketing, GSEs) 
- Auto Finance 
- Student Loans 
- Commercial Loans (including commercial real estate) 
- Other consumer finance 
- Equipment Finance 
- Deposits 
- Capital Markets (securitization, prime broker, equity / debt issuance) 
- Derivatives 
- Structured Products 
- Insurance 
- Capital Planning 
- Liquidity Planning 
 Functional Capabilities 
 Prior experience of the following topical areas is highly preferred:
- Auditing 
- SEC filings and disclosures 
- Control testing 
- Risk and Control Assessments. 
- Process mapping/flows. 
- Business process / control remediation. 
- Business analysts (user requirement development / user acceptance testing); 
- Credit risk management. 
- Financial risk management. 
- Quantitative analytics. 
- Valuation of financial instruments. 
- Project / program managers. 
- RPA, current knowledge of AI used for segmentation, pricing/complaint analysis. 
 Basic Qualifications 
- Master’s degree or equivalent in accounting, finance, or a related field; alternatively, completion of a five-year accelerated accounting program, or a combined bachelor's and master's degree is highly preferred. 
- Minimum two to four (2-4) years of relevant experience in an accounting or Big Four consulting firm, specializing in audit, forensics, or dispute and damages matters. 
- Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation, or documented progress toward obtaining the CPA, is important for long-term career advancement. 
- Demonstrated proficiency with Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. 
- Thorough grasp of accounting principles and financial statements, such as GAAP, along with understanding how debits and credits relate to the statement of cash flow, income statement, balance sheet, and trial balance. 
- Prior work experience with a focus on financial services in a consulting environment preferred. 
- Strong PowerPoint presentation skills/techniques. Ability to create decks and agendas that provide robust transparency as to project status. 
- Proven capability with MS Excel. A desire to expand those capabilities is required, as is the ability to train others to use such tools. 
- Desire and ability to manage processes and other more junior staff, as necessary. 
- Commitment to producing high quality analyses and attention to details. 
- Keen interest in economic or financial analyses and research. 
- Strong verbal and written communication skills; and 
- Desire to work within a team environment. 
- Ability to travel to client sites on demand is required. 
 Salary: $100,000 - $175,000 per year
 Job title and compensation to be determined based on qualifications and experience.   
 Candidate must be able to submit verification of his/her legal right to work in the U.S., without company sponsorship. 
 About BRG 
 BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead. 
 At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.
 Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.
 At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.

 Our Advisory team provide a wide variety of services that deliver value-led advice and outcomes. The team work across strategy, operations and improvement as well as at a transactional and defined project level. From technology to risk advisory, they’re experts in following through on top-level instructions and resolving the finer details – all in one straight-forward package. When you join them, you’ll work on some of the world's most exciting financial operations and business deals, building your experience and expertise alongside the brightest minds in the industry. 
 We’ll help you succeed 
 Leading organisations trust us because of the quality of our advice. That quality grows from a thorough understanding of their business, and that understanding comes from working closely with them and building long-lasting relationships. 
 You’ll be someone who is both comfortable working pro-actively and managing your own tasks, as well as confident collaborating with others and communicating regularly with senior managers, directors, and BDO’s partners to help businesses effectively. You’ll be encouraged to identify and draw attention to opportunities for enhancing our delivery and providing additional services to organisations we work with. . 
As a Senior Analyst or Analyst you'll join our Tech, Risk & Governance team (TRG) part of our Digital practice withing Consulting. This is a rapidly growing business area. You'll help clients understand and manage the risks arising from technology, transformation and digital change. The client base is diverse and you'll support technology risk assessments, IT internal audits, controls assurance and advisory engagements that strengthen governance, resilience and confidence in our clients most critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a high performing digital team and develop your career.
 You'll be someone with: 
- Experience in technology risk, IT internal audit, IT assurance, risk and controls, or a closely related discipline, gained in professional services, financial services or another regulated organisation. 
- Experience in one or more relevant areas: IT general controls and SOX/ICFR; cloud risk; DevOps and SDLC controls; ERP risk and controls; operational resilience; third-party technology risk; data or AI governance; end-user computing; programme assurance 
- Financial services experience is desirable such as banks. insurers, asset managers, payments or capital markets organisations and frameworks such as FCA and PRA requirements, operational resilience and outsourcing or third-party risk expectations.

There may be a need to travel as needed for client and internal business needs. 
 Operating in the global marketplace means multinational companies face a variety of different business, cultural, language and regulatory environments. Our IGS line of business helps these companies navigate the challenges of multi-country complexity based on context knowledge of trends and innovative multi-client solutions. In particular, we help multinational companies develop global/cross-border solutions that meet the needs of both local and headquarter management in the design, establishment, financing, operation, oversight and monitoring of their compensation and benefit programs around the world. In doing so, we work closely with our local offices in other geographies, as well as subject matter experts in other segments. 
 Our Global Benefits Management (GBM) business has a particular focus around the coordination of insured employee benefits, and also has the breadth to consider other Benefits and Total Reward aspects as demanded by our clients. The GBM business is one of the fastest growing areas of our business with an expanding marketplace and exciting, evolving client needs. As an Associate Manager in our GBM delivery team, you will play a key part in this growth story, taking a lead role in delivering across multiple focus areas and geographies to some of our biggest multinational clients.
 The Role 
- Manage multiple client engagements. 
- Contribute to client delivery teams, providing guidance and training to junior team members as needed, and take responsibility for client deliverables 
- Operate on teams providing advice on global health, risk and other benefits. 
- Engage with clients, building relationships and provide consistent, superior project delivery. 
- Manage large International consulting client engagements: 
- Coordinate teams and promote effective working 
- Develop project plans for execution of large, global engagements 
- Ensure project managers are maintaining team progress against goals 
- Build relationships internally and collaborate effectively on cross-functional and cross-regional teams. 
- Partnering with regional/ local Health & Benefits, International consultants and regional/local geography teams 
- Contribute to relationships with internal and external sources to maximize the activity on key target accounts 
 What you’ll bring 
- 3+ years of project management, client facing or consulting experience 
- Employee benefits experience, preferably with health and risk benefits, Rewards or HR expertise (across multiple countries is a bonus) 
- Fluent in English language (Fluency in a Scandinavian language is a bonus). 
- Track record of success in managing client contact relationships, demonstrating ability to communicate clearly in a client-facing role 
- Ability to work both on their own and with client teams, including virtual work teams with members in different geographic locations. 
- Understanding of the nuances of working across borders, with different cultures and with multinational organizations,

jd_text:
The Senior Consultant – Nature and Environment will support the delivery and growth of ICF’s portfolio of work for Defra and its arm’s-length bodies, with a particular focus on natural environment policy. The role is designed for someone who can combine strong project management with relevant technical, research and policy expertise. The postholder will manage multiple projects, contribute directly to technical delivery, and support the mobilisation of new work across biodiversity, nature recovery, protected sites and related environmental policy areas.
 Key responsibilities 
 Technical delivery – nature and environment 
- Contribute technical expertise to monitoring, evaluation, research and learning projects in the natural environment field. 
- Support the design of evaluation questions, theories of change, monitoring frameworks, research methods and evidence synthesis approaches. 
- Undertake and oversee qualitative and quantitative research, analysis and reporting, ensuring outputs are robust, practical and accessible to policy audiences. 
- Apply knowledge of UK environmental policy and delivery contexts to interpret evidence and develop useful conclusions and recommendations. 
- Provide technical review and quality assurance for the work of junior colleagues and delivery partners. 
 Project and delivery management 
- Manage a portfolio of small and medium-sized nature- and environment-related projects, taking responsibility for delivery planning, resourcing, budgets, risks, quality and client reporting. 
- Mobilise new projects quickly, establishing proportionate governance, clear roles, realistic workplans and effective project controls. 
- Coordinate multidisciplinary ICF teams and delivery partners, ensuring inputs are integrated and deadlines are met. 
- Monitor progress, dependencies, risks and financial performance, taking timely corrective action where required. 
- Maintain clear and constructive client relationships, provide concise progress updates and manage changes to scope or delivery expectations 
 Business development and portfolio support 
- Contribute to project plans and bids, including shaping methods, workplans, resourcing and budgets. 
- Work flexibly across ICF’s environment portfolio, supporting priority projects and emerging client needs. 
- Help identify opportunities to retain and grow nature and environment work within ICF. 
- Support the development of reusable methods, tools, guidance and learning across the team. 
- Coach junior staff, supporting their technical and project delivery development. 
 Qualifications and experience 
- Degree or equivalent professional experience in environmental policy, ecology, environmental science, social research, evaluation, economics or a related discipline. 
- Relevant consulting, research, policy or programme delivery experience, with demonstrable responsibility for managing projects or substantial workstreams. 
- Knowledge of UK natural environment policy and delivery, such as biodiversity, nature recovery, protected sites, land management or environmental monitoring. 
- Experience of monitoring, evaluation, applied research or evidence-based policy work. 
- Strong project management skills, including planning, resourcing, risk management, budget oversight and quality assurance. 
- Ability to contribute technically while maintaining oversight of delivery, commercial performance and client requirements. 
- Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear client-ready outputs. 
- Experience working collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and external partners. 
 Desirable experience 
- Experience delivering work for Defra, its arm’s-length bodies or other UK public-sector clients. 
- Experience of theory-based, process, impact or value-for-money evaluation. 
- Knowledge of biodiversity targets, nature recovery, protected sites or place-based environmental delivery. 
- Experience managing supplier or partner inputs within a consultancy delivery model. 
- Experience contributing to competitive proposals and developing costed workplans. 
 Personal qualities 
- Delivery-focused, organised and able to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment. 
- Collaborative and pragmatic, with the judgement to know when to resolve issues directly and when to escalate. 
- Confident working with multidisciplinary teams, clients and delivery partners. 
- Committed to quality, inclusion, learning and continuous improvement. 
 Additional points 
- The role is expected to combine project management with substantive technical contribution; it is not a dedicated non-technical PM position. 
- The postholder may work across several thematic areas and projects, depending on demand and subject-matter fit. 
- The role will support both secured delivery and the development and mobilisation of new work.

 Learn more about what we do and our commitment to inclusion . 
 The benefits of joining ICF: 
 Our people at ICF are our most important asset, so we invest in them from the moment they arrive. When you join our team, you’ll have access to a vast array of benefits to help you live your life well.

 Principales responsabilidades:
- Elaborar, revisar y actualizar reportes técnicos de sostenibilidad y desempeño socioambiental. 
- Recopilar, sistematizar y analizar información e indicadores ESG de distintas áreas. 
- Organizar y mantener la documentación y las evidencias requeridas para procesos de certificación y auditoría. 
- Dar seguimiento a planes de acción, compromisos y requerimientos de información. 
- Apoyar la identificación de brechas frente a estándares internacionales y la preparación de recomendaciones.
 Requisitos: 
- Título universitario en Ingeniería, Ciencias Ambientales, Ciencias Sociales o disciplinas afines. 
- Experiencia en gestión ambiental y social (E&S), criterios ESG y relacionamiento con grupos de interés. 
- Conocimiento de estándares internacionales, incluyendo IFC Performance Standards, Principios de Ecuador y marcos de reporte ESG y sostenibilidad. 
- Disponibilidad para realizar viajes según las necesidades de los proyectos 
 Antecedentes: 
 Desde que establecimos nos establecimos en la región de América Latina y el Caribe (LAC) en la década de 1990, ERM ha crecido de manera constante, empleando ahora a más de 800 profesionales en sus oficinas de Argentina, Brasil, Colombia, Guyana, México y Perú. Durante más de 30 años, hemos construido equipos de consultoría de clase mundial, especializados en medio ambiente, sostenibilidad y consultoría social, con una sólida base de clientes en múltiples sectores económicos como petróleo y gas, manufactura y productos químicos, entre otros. A lo largo de tiempos desafiantes, ERM ha permanecido comprometida en apoyar a estos sectores, ya que nuestros clientes continúan invirtiendo en el mercado local.
 Como parte de nuestra expansión regional, ERM busca mantener el liderazgo en la industria asociándose con importantes clientes que comparten nuestro compromiso con la sostenibilidad. Con una base sólida en industrias clave, somos pioneros en el avance de la agenda ESG (Ambiental, Social y de Gobernanza) en América Latina y el Caribe. Job Description
 Are you an experienced consultant in technical due diligence and transaction advisory? Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative, and empowering culture? Are you looking for your next challenge?

 Your new role 
 As a Senior Consultant or Chief Consultant, you will be a central member of a highly professional and dynamic team with exposure to clients and projects around the world. - Cooperation with team members and technical experts based globally in the organization 
- Leading or participating in conference calls with clients, financial and legal advisors

jd_text:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
 About the Job You’re Considering 
 The Strategy and Transformation consultant supports Capgemini clients to innovate and develop new strategies, services and products. He/she designs and implements new business and operating models and brings to life the organizations of the future. He/she develops customer insights, organizational knowledge and market perspectives.
 As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design — augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our Enterprise Transformation team is looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.
 The Process Excellence team helps clients improve how work gets done across core enterprise processes by combining process design, process mining, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled / agentic approaches to drive measurable business outcomes. The work is practical and value-focused: identifying inefficiencies, surfacing root causes through data, redesigning workflows, improving control and performance, and building roadmaps that translate operational pain points into real transformation. It is a strong fit for people who like solving complex business problems in a structured, evidence-based way and who can connect AI, intelligent automation, and process insight to broader enterprise transformation.
 Your Role 
 He or she continues to focus on learning tools, ways of working within a specific industry or expertise. He or she works in different roles on different projects across domains to build it skills in a given domain of expertise or industry.
 As a consultant you’ll help clients improve core enterprise processes using process mining, analytics, and intelligent automation. This is practical transformation: finding what’s broken, quantifying the value, and building a roadmap for improvement - often with GenAI as an accelerant, not a gimmick.
 You will:
- Document workflows and identify improvement and automation opportunities 
- Support process mining and process discovery initiatives (data prep, analysis, insights) 
- Build performance reporting (KPIs, dashboards, trend analysis) to quantify impact 
- Support automation backlogs and transformation roadmaps tied to business value 
- Support workshops and synthesis into clear recommendations 
- Track emerging GenAI/automation trends and translate into applicable use cases 
 Your Skills + Experience 
 You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI‑enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI‑augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI‑driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments.
 Required Experience
- 2–5 years in process improvement, BPM, automation, or business analysis 
- Familiarity with tools like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio (or similar) 
- Strong analytical mindset and comfort working with data 
- Lean six sigma certification preferred 
- Exposure to core enterprise processes (O2C, P2P, AR/AP) is a plus 
- Clear communicator; strong collaboration in client environments 
 The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is $67,500 - $127,510.

- Regularly review and update security policies and procedures to ensure they comply with current best practices and legal requirements. 
- Planning, implementation and evaluation of training and workshops in the areas of occupational safety and health protection for our customers. 
- On-site diagnostics to assess the current safety culture and develop tailor-made solutions to build a strong safety culture in our customer companies. 
- Travel regularly to our client, both in Italy and abroad.

 Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. Job Description
 Hybrid-based position in our Monterrey office. 
 Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex policy issues? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?
 If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future. For consideration, please supply an English CV. 
 Your new role 
 Ramboll is seeking a highly motivated Environmental, Health and Safety Consultant to join the firm! We invite you to bring your strong analytical abilities into play as you evaluate regulatory compliance risks, contamination and other environmental, health and safety issues.
 Your key responsibilities will be:
- Completing environmental site assessments of industrial and commercial sites and conducting due diligence reviews of multi-site portfolios for attorneys, lenders, developers, and industrial clients. 
- Completing and managing limited environmental compliance reviews of industrial sites by reviewing and abstracting regulatory requirements for multi-media environmental compliance. 
- Preparing, assembling, and submitting federal and state environmental permit applications, including air emissions, wastewater discharge, hazardous waste registration, and land use/impact permits, along with required technical attachments and application fees. 
- Supporting the preparation of environmental impact studies, including sections and technical appendices, under Mexican regulatory frameworks, and supporting projects in achieving conformance and compliance with international sustainability standards. 
- Approximately 40% travel, mainly within Mexico. 
Qualifications
 About You 
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental, Chemical Engineering or Sciences, Sustainability, Mechanical or Civil Engineering or other related Engineering, Environmental Science, or Geology field with related consulting experience. Masters’ degree in related field is a plus and 
- 3+ years of related EHS experience. 
- Must be bilingual in English and Spanish. A valid driver's license and passport required. 
Additional Information
 What we can offer you 
- Investment in your development 
- Being valued for the unique person you are 
- Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects 
- The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company Ready to join us? 
 Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV in English . We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.
 Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.
 Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

 Our practice comprises three work areas:
- Value Strategy & Modelling (VSM): Business case development, value realisation planning and shaping of outcome based commercial structures for major client decisions and deals. 
- Strategic Finance Delivery : Connects strategy to performance by building integrated planning, forecasting, cost management, and finance delivery capabilities that strengthen decision‑making and operational efficiency.

 As a Senior Consultant, you will have substantial expertise in Strategic Finance Delivery, whilst also being able to work flexibly across the wider Enterprise Model & Strategy portfolio. In this role you will contribute to the practice as follows: 
- Lead the delivery of large and complex Strategic Finance Improvement or transformation projects, collaborating with clients and teams to rapidly define business challenges and shape actionable solutions grounded in strategic thinking and evidence-based insights. 
- Develop and present meaningful recommendations, ensuring they are practical, robust, and withstand client scrutiny while leveraging the latest strategic transformation trends. 
- Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor at all levels and identifying business development opportunities across operating model transformation, and organisation design. 
- Coach and develop team members, providing performance management, fostering leadership, and supporting recruitment to grow the team
. 
 As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
 Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
 Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
 Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.
 Your Profile 
 To succeed in the role, you will bring the following experience & attributes
 Consulting Expertise: 
- Strong background in management consulting, with a proven ability to build and guide teams, mobilise workstreams, and deliver projects successfully. 
- Proven experience shaping actionable finance strategies, designing finance target operating models, and developing performance architectures that link strategy to measurable business outcomes 
 Strategic Thinking, Problem Solving, Stakeholder Management & Communication :
- Ability to quickly understand complex business challenges and shape evidence‑based solutions that deliver meaningful impact. 
- Strong analytical skills, ensuring recommendations are grounded in robust data and stand up to senior‑level scrutiny. 
- Confident working with senior executives, able to build trusted relationships and secure alignment for transformation initiatives. 
 Execution & Delivery 
- Skilled in structuring, planning, and leading delivery of project workstreams. 
- Experience contributing to service redesign or transformation programmes, particularly those enhancing customer or user experience through digital tools and capabilities. 
 Business Development & Practice Growth 
- Comfortable identifying new opportunities, expanding client relationships, and supporting sales activities. 
- Experience helping to shape compelling value propositions, proposals, or thought leadership that drives growth. 
 Credibility as a Finance Professional 
- A fully qualified UK Chartered Accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), or
Currently progressing toward qualification and on track to complete within the next 12 months.

 What You'll Love About Working Here

- Learning & development - Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 
 Your Profile 
 As a member of the Data & AI Strategy Team you’ll be part of the future of AI consulting. At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
 Your role: 
 As Copilot Strategy, Change & Adoption Consultant you will help our clients set the strategic direction for Microsoft Copilot in the workplace, and then make it land. You will pair technology strategy with the change, communications and adoption craft needed to turn Copilot licences into everyday productivity and a genuinely AI-enabled workforce. In this role you will play a key part in:
- Setting the Copilot adoption strategy : Shaping a clear strategic vision for Microsoft Copilot - spanning Microsoft 365 opilot, Copilot Chat, Agent Builder, Copilot Studio and emerging workplace AI capabilities such as Cowork and Scout - aligned to security, data and automation capabilities. 
- Driving adoption: Designing and delivering user-centric change and adoption campaigns at scale that tackle AI scepticism, build capability and embed new ways of working. 
- Leading complex engagements : Owning delivery excellence on Copilot strategy and adoption workstreams, escalating and de-risking complex situations as the technology evolves. 
- Growing the practice : Helping develop the Copilot portfolio and client relationships to generate new opportunities and revenue, and coaching colleagues towards high performance and a positive culture. 
 As part of your role, you will also be expected to drive the following activities:
 Client Advisory and Delivery 
- Strategy and Vision : Develop AI workforce transformation strategies, advising senior stakeholders on Microsoft Copilot capabilities, adoption strategy across workforce groups and business functions, business change requirements, and opportunities to create value through AI-enabled ways of working. 
- Ways of working Reinvention : Lead work redesign initiatives that leverage AI to enhance productivity, employee experience and organisational outcomes through future-state practices, AI-enabled workflows and effective human-AI collaboration. Facilitate workshops to understand current and future ways of working. 
- Change and Adoption: Lead organisational change and adoption programmes from pilot-to-scale that enable successful Copilot deployment through communications, training, engagement, leadership alignment and persona-led adoption plans. Tackle AI scepticism and respond to concerns to increase trust. 
- Enablement and Community: Stand up champions networks, training curricula, prompt libraries and enablement assets that sustain adoption as the Copilot estate and feature set evolve. Be innovative! 
- Benefit Realisation: Lead value realisation activities for Copilot programmes, creating measurement frameworks, defining success indicators and helping clients translate adoption and productivity gains into tangible business outcomes. 
- Senior Stakeholder Engagement: Lead executive engagement and value communications activities, helping senior stakeholders communicate the vision for AI, demonstrate outcomes and align business and technology leaders around Copilot adoption. 
 In summary you will be required to:
 1. Lead client workshops and transformation workstreams.
2. Manage small consulting teams and workstreams.
3. Develop high-quality client deliverables and recommendations.
4. Facilitate discussions with business, technology and change stakeholders.
5. Translate complex AI concepts into practical business outcomes.
6. Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.
 Capability Development 
- Inspire clients with thought-leadership on AI and Copilot trends for the workplace, and opportunities to direct their investment towards transformative work – led by ethical principles.

- Drive experimentation on Copilot adoption approaches to explore new ways to serve our clients and stay at the forefront of innovation. 
- Identify opportunities to accelerate your team’s upskilling in Copilot, investing in new training and certifications to keep pace with the technology. 
- Stay informed of the competitive technology landscape and assess the feasibility of deploying Generative and Agentic AI solutions such as Microsoft Copilot. Business Development

- Collaborate with stakeholders across Capgemini to understand client needs and shape new deals with expert solutions. 
- Drive solution development, including input into staffing, skill requirements and functional ideation across the delivery lifecycle. 
 Your profile: 
 Capgemini Invent DNA 
- Highly collaborative, able to expand your network within Capgemini to promote the Workplace AI offerings whilst advocating for other teams’ capabilities to your clients. 
- A passion for continuous learning and a willingness to develop those around you – both clients and colleagues. 
- Drive performance and continuous improvement, inspiring and celebrating a culture of boldness. Leadership 
- Getting buy-in and aligning senior business and technical leaders on the benefits of AI technology, using strong communication, presentation and analytical skills. 
- Ability to build, grow and coach cross-functional teams, driving cohesion and contributing to the wellbeing of your people. 
- Upholding strong ethical values, consistently making the conscious choice to ‘do the right thing’ in business and in leading your team. Business and Methods 
- Ability to shape and convey compelling storytelling around our Workplace AI offers and the business value on offer. 
- Proven experience designing and delivering change, communications and adoption at scale, with tangible behavioural results. 
- Proven experience applying strategy and innovation approaches to solve complex, analytical and technical business problems. 
- Strong project management skills, well-versed in agile principles, and confident managing timelines, budgets and resources. Technical 
- Working understanding of Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Chat), first-party agents and Agent Builder, and the wider Microsoft AI stack or Anthropic stack, sufficient to build credibility with senior client stakeholders.

jd_text:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
 About the Job You’re Considering
 As AI reshapes how organizations operate, compete, and create value, we are evolving our consulting model to be AI-enabled by design, augmenting human judgment with analytics, automation, and generative AI. Our teams are looking for consultants who are not only strong problem solvers, but who are excited to work differently in an AI-first world: curious, adaptable, and ready to help clients reimagine how work gets done.
 The Contact Center Transformation team combines customer interaction data, service design, conversational AI, intelligent automation, platforms, and agent experience to create measurable service outcomes.
 Your Role
 As a Consultant, AI Customer Service Transformation , you will support the design, development, and delivery of AI-enabled customer service solutions, working closely with business stakeholders, customer service teams, product owners, and technical specialists. You will help clients translate business needs into actionable requirements, conversational experiences, and product features while contributing to the successful delivery of Generative AI and Conversational AI solutions.
 You will leverage analytical thinking, customer-centric design principles, and AI-enabled ways of working to identify opportunities, improve customer and agent experiences, and support the implementation of scalable AI-driven solutions that create measurable business value. 
 Key Responsibilities Include
- Gather and document business requirements through stakeholder interviews, workshops, process analysis, customer journey reviews, and assessment of customer interactions. 
- Develop user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, customer journeys, business requirements, and functional specifications to support solution design and delivery. 
- Design conversational experiences including intents, dialogue flows, prompts, responses, escalation paths, fallback handling, and human-agent handoffs. 
- Analyze customer conversations, operational data, and service performance metrics to identify automation opportunities and customer experience improvements. 
- Support product backlog management, use case prioritization, sprint planning, requirements refinement, and agile delivery activities. 
- Collaborate closely with AI developers, architects, data specialists, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective AI-enabled solutions. 
- Execute functional testing, conversational testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and defect management activities while driving continuous improvement. 
- Support client presentations, workshops, solution demonstrations, business case development, and project deliverables. 
 Your Skills + Experience
 You bring strong AI literacy, including core AI and generative AI concepts, and understand how these capabilities apply to enterprise transformation. You are able to identify and support AI-enabled opportunities that improve business outcomes and delivery effectiveness, and you have experience working in AI-augmented ways of working to enhance research, analysis, and solution development. You collaborate effectively across strategy, technology, data, and design to enable AI-driven solutions, with a solid understanding of responsible AI principles such as ethics, privacy, security, and governance. You demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset around emerging AI capabilities and their practical application in client environments. 
 Required Experience
- 2-5 years of experience in consulting, business analysis, product management, customer experience, customer service transformation, or contact center operations. 
- Strong analytical skills and demonstrated experience gathering requirements, documenting business processes, developing user stories, and translating business needs into actionable solutions. 
- Experience with customer journey mapping, service design, conversational design, digital experience design, or related customer transformation initiatives. 
- Understanding of Generative AI, Conversational AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and their application within customer service and operational environments. 
- Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies, product management practices, backlog management, and iterative solution development. 
- Understanding of contact center processes, customer service operations, customer support workflows, and service performance metrics. 
- Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills. 
- Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, technology teams, AI specialists, and cross-functional project teams within a consulting environment. Preferred Experience
- Hands-on experience with conversational AI platforms, virtual assistant design, prompt engineering, chatbot implementation, or AI solution testing. 
- Exposure to leading customer service and CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Genesys, NICE, Five9, or comparable technologies. 
- Experience supporting AI, digital transformation, or customer service modernization programs. 
 The base compensation range for this role in the posted location is: $67,500 - $127,510 
 Capgemini provides compensation range information in accordance with applicable national, state, provincial, and local pay transparency laws. The base compensation range listed for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Capgemini, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting. This range may be subject to change as permitted by law. 
 The actual compensation offered to any candidate may fall outside of the posted range and will be determined based on multiple factors legally permitted in the applicable jurisdiction. 
 These may include, but are not limited to: Geographic location, Education and qualifications, Certifications and licenses, Relevant experience and skills, Seniority and performance, Market and business consideration, Internal pay equity. 
 It is not typical for candidates to be hired at or near the top of the posted compensation range. 
 In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for additional compensation such as variable incentives, bonuses, or commissions, depending on the position and applicable laws. 
 Capgemini offers a comprehensive, non-negotiable benefits package to all regular, full-time employees. In the U.S. and Canada, available benefits are determined by local policy and eligibility and may include: 
- Paid time off based on employee grade (A-F), defined by policy: Vacation: 12-25 days, depending on grade, Company paid holidays, Personal Days, Sick Leave 
- Medical, dental, and vision coverage (or provincial healthcare coordination in Canada) 
- Retirement savings plans (e.g., 401(k) in the U.S., RRSP in Canada) 
- Life and disability insurance 
- Employee assistance programs 
- Other benefits as provided by local policy and eligibility Important Notice: Compensation (including bonuses, commissions, or other forms of incentive pay) is not considered earned, vested, or payable until it becomes due under the terms of applicable plans or agreements and is subject to Capgemini’s discretion, consistent with applicable laws. The Company reserves the right to amend or withdraw compensation programs at any time, within the limits of applicable legislation. 
 Disclaimers 
 Capgemini is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging inclusion in the workplace. Capgemini also participates in the Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations (PAIR) program which supports meaningful engagement with Indigenous communities across Canada by promoting fairness, accessibility, inclusion and respect. We value the rich cultural heritage and contributions of Indigenous Peoples and actively work to create a welcoming and respectful environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity/expression, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, genetics, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristic protected by law.

Physical, mental, sensory or environmental demands may be referenced in an attempt to communicate the manner in which this position traditionally is performed. Whenever necessary to provide individuals with disabilities an equal employment opportunity, Capgemini will consider reasonable accommodations that might involve varying job requirements and/or changing the way this job is performed, provided that such accommodation does not pose an undue hardship. Capgemini is committed to providing reasonable accommodation during our recruitment process. If you need assistance or accommodation, please reach out to your recruiting contact.

With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

jd_text:
CAPGEMINI INVENT 
 At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
 Join our AI Factory team and be part of the future of AI consulting. We are redefining how organisations adopt and scale AI, moving beyond experimentation to embedding agentic systems, human-AI workflows and data products into every aspect of how they operate, compete, and create value. 
 As a Consultant / Senior Consultant within our AI Factory team, you will help clients unlock measurable value from data and AI by translating business challenges into practical solutions that improve performance, accelerate growth, increase operational effectiveness and enable innovation with confidence, whilst contributing to the growth of our AI Factory practice. 
 YOUR ROLE 
 This role is perfect for someone who enjoys solving real business problems and turning emerging data and AI technologies into practical solutions. You’ll work alongside experienced consultants, client stakeholders and technical specialists to design and deliver solutions that augment human judgement, improve decision-making and transform business processes - from improving customer service outcomes and optimising supply chains, to enabling smarter marketing decisions. 
 We Make AI Useful. You will help clients identify and deliver high-value opportunities where data and AI can solve real business problems and deliver measurable outcomes. 
 Work with client stakeholders to understand business challenges and user needs, translating these into practical data and AI use cases, products and solutions. 
 Support the prioritisation and delivery of AI use cases based on business value, feasibility and user needs, applying modern data and AI technologies to develop solutions such as Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation and advanced analytics. 
 Help measure and demonstrate the impact of data and AI solutions through adoption, performance and business outcome metrics, supporting clients in moving from experimentation towards practical adoption. 
 We Make AI Usable. You will help design solutions around the needs of users and the way organisations operate. 
 Design and develop user-centric AI products, copilots, intelligent assistants and agentic workflows that meet user and business needs, working across cloud and data platforms including Azure, AWS and GCP. 
 Understand how AI can be embedded into business processes, customer journeys and decision-making, working collaboratively with business, product, design and engineering teams to deliver practical solutions. 
 Support deployment, adoption and change by translating complex technical concepts into clear recommendations and practical experiences for business users, while contributing to iterative and Agile delivery. 
 We Make AI Reliable. You will help build trusted data and technology foundations that enable AI solutions to be deployed safely and at scale. 
 Develop and work with AI-ready data platforms, data products and analytical solutions, ensuring data is accessible, fit for purpose and ready to support AI use cases. 
 Support data quality, governance and the application of Responsible AI, security, privacy and compliance principles throughout delivery. 
 Contribute to scalable data and AI architectures and support the delivery of reliable, observable and maintainable solutions, taking ownership of defined deliverables and workstreams within multidisciplinary teams. 
 As part of your role you will be able to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 
 Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
 Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
 Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demanded within the company, accreditations, certifications etc. 
 YOUR PROFILE 
 We are looking for individuals who combine analytical and technical capability, consulting skills and a passion for using data and AI to solve real business problems. 
 We don't expect you to have every skill below. We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and are interested in people who demonstrate curiosity, a willingness to learn and the ability to apply technology to practical challenges. 
 Data & AI Transformation Experience: 
 Experience in data, analytics, AI or digital transformation through consulting, technology, engineering, academia or industry. 
 Ability to translate business challenges and user needs into practical data and AI solutions. 
 Experience working in Agile or iterative delivery teams, with an understanding of product development principles including requirements, prioritisation, backlogs and iterative delivery. 
 Interest in how Generative AI, Agentic AI and automation can transform business processes and decision-making. 
 Data, AI & Intelligent Systems Expertise: 
 Experience or strong interest in one or more of the following: 
 Generative AI, LLMs, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI applications 
 Agentic AI, AI agents, intelligent assistants and AI-enabled automation 
 Prompt engineering, AI evaluation and Responsible AI 
 AI orchestration frameworks e.g. LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Model Context Protocol (MCP) 
 Data engineering, pipelines, modelling and governance 
 Advanced analytics, machine learning and statistical modelling 
 Data visualisation and insight solutions 
 Candidates should understand the importance of trusted, accessible and AI-ready data, and be curious about how AI can be embedded into business processes and decision-making. 
 Technical Skills: 
 Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: 
 Programming & Analytics – Python, SQL, R, Spark, machine learning and advanced analytics 
 Cloud & Data Platforms – Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS and GCP 
 AI Technologies – GenAI frameworks, Agentic AI, vector databases, semantic search, knowledge retrieval and LLM application development 
 Data & Visualisation – Power BI, Tableau, Looker and other business intelligence tools 
 Consulting, Communication & Leadership: 
 Ability to work effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. 
 Strong communication, problem-solving and storytelling skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences. 
 Ownership of the quality and timely delivery of your work. 
 Collaborative, inclusive and adaptable working style. 
 Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and ways of working. 
 For Senior Consultant candidates, ownership of larger workstreams, support for junior colleagues and contribution to client or business development are desirable. 
 We know great candidates may not meet every requirement. If you are excited by the role and believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply. 
 Additional Information 
 The role offers the opportunity to work on leading-edge AI and analytics programmes in a collaborative consulting environment. Candidates must be eligible for SC Security Clearance and should be willing to travel as required by client engagements. Capgemini also offers hybrid working, flexible working arrangements and a strong focus on employee wellbeing, inclusion and professional development. 
 WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE? 
 As a Consultant / Senior Consultant, you will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI and analytics innovation, contributing to cutting-edge projects that shape industries, while advancing your own career in a collaborative and inspiring environment. 
 We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page
 NEED TO KNOW 
 At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work. 
 We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 
 Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
 Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 
 Declare they have a disability, and 
 Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 
 Please opt in during the application process. 
 CSR: 
 We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing. 
 Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 
 We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.
 ABOUT CAPGEMINI 
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 
Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

jd_text:
CAPGEMINI INVENT 
 At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us in driving transformation that not only solves our clients’ current challenges but unlocks future value and delivers lasting impact. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.
 Join Capgemini’s Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) team working at the forefront of data + AI. You’ll play an influential role in designing and shaping data & AI foundations that power cutting-edge AI, agentic AI and advanced analytics, ensuring our clients trust their data, scale intelligent products and accelerate business impact.
 YOUR ROLE 
 This role sits at the intersection of advisory, strategy and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on shaping vision and guiding clients through complex data challenges. From enabling AI-ready data foundations to embedding ethical governance for advanced analytics, you’ll help organisations unlock the full potential of their data.
- We ADVISE on data, analytics and AI strategy – You will act as a trusted advisor, shaping vision and defining AI-driven data management strategies, articulating the business benefits of robust governance, quality and MDM capabilities. 
- We TRANSLATE complexity into clarity – You will guide and influence senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical concepts and business priorities to secure buy-in and drive cultural change toward data-driven outcomes. 
- We DESIGN operating models – You will define and design elements of the data management operating model, including roles, processes, standards and stewardship frameworks, embedding these into client organisations. 
- We ENABLE trusted AI and analytics – You will support the discovery and design of data governance, data quality and master data management solutions that ensure compliance, transparency and ethical AI practices.

jd_text:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
 Your role 
 As a Senior Transformation Consultant, you will independently lead transformation workstreams and own delivery from planning to go-live, while helping shape the approach and supporting colleagues. 
 Your tasks 
- Lead workstreams independently, applying PMO practices: own planning, delivery, risks and stakeholders 
- Facilitate workshops that drive alignment and decisions across business, technology and procurement stakeholders, often in an international setting 
- Prepare steering committee materials and present to senior stakeholders 
- Coach less experienced team members 
- Lead target operating model design (processes, roles, governance) and its translation into blueprints, policies and KPIs, with a focus on procurement and, in some projects, supply chain management (SCM) 
- Optimise end-to-end procurement processes (e.g. source-to-contract, procure-to-pay, supplier management) to unlock efficiency, compliance and savings; in SCM projects also planning, logistics and order-to-cash 
- Steer ERP and procurement technology implementations (e.g. SAP Ariba, S/4HANA, Coupa; SAP IBP in SCM projects), from fit-gap to testing and cutover 
- Drive change management, communication and business readiness activities that deliver real user adoption 
- Oversee training and knowledge transfer for procurement (and, where relevant, supply chain) users 
- Lead cutover planning, go-live readiness and hypercare 
 Your profile 
- Have a track record of leading workstreams in transformation, change or implementation projects 
- Have solid experience in procurement (or alternatively SCM) and know its processes and operating models well 
- Can structure complex work, manage senior stakeholders and communicate clearly with business and technology teams 
- Work well in international settings and are fluent in English and German Nice to have: 
- Experience with ERP and procurement systems (e.g. SAP, Ariba, Coupa) or supply chain systems (e.g. IBP) 
- Experience in change management or business readiness, and in coaching colleagues 
- PMO or project management certification (e.g. PRINCE2, PMP, Prosci) 
 What You'll love about working here 
- Practical benefits: yearly financial bonus, private medical care with Medicover with additional packages (e.g., dental, senior care, oncology) available on preferential terms, life insurance and access to NAIS benefit platform. 
- Access to over 70 training tracks with certification opportunities (e.g., GenAI, Excel, Business Analysis, Project Management) on our NEXT platform. Dive into a world of knowledge with free access to Education First languages platform, TED Talks and Udemy Business materials and trainings. 
- Cutting-Edge Technology: Position yourself at the forefront of IT innovation, working with the latest technologies and platforms. Capgemini partners with top global enterprises, including 145 Fortune 500 companies. 
- Enjoy hybrid working model that fits your life - after completing onboarding, connect work from a modern office with ergonomic work from home, thanks to home office package (including laptop, monitor, and chair). Ask your recruiter about the details. 
 Get to know us 
 Capgemini is committed to diversity and inclusion, ensuring fairness in all employment practices. We evaluate individuals based on qualifications and performance, not personal characteristics, striving to create a workplace where everyone can succeed and feel valued. 
 Do you want to get to know us better? Check our Instagram — @capgeminipl or visit our Facebook profile — Capgemini Polska . You can also find us on YouTube . 
 About Capgemini 
 Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion. 
 Make it real | www.capgemini.com

 Who are we? 
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world. 
 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities. 
 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
